AI.summary: 扩散模型在图像动画中受限于视频数据稀缺和新颖运动模式泛化能力差。为解决此问题，本文提出了模块化图像到视频适配器（MIVA）。MIVA是一种轻量级、可附加的子网络，每个模块专门捕获单一运动模式，支持并行扩展。它可以在极少样本（约十个）上高效训练。在推理阶段，用户通过选择MIVA来精确指定运动，从而避免了提示工程。实验证明MIVA能实现更精确的运动控制，并维持与大型数据集训练模型相当或更高的生成质量。
AI.keywords: 少样本, 模块化适配器, 图像到视频, 扩散模型, 运动控制
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了模块化、少样本的学习范式（MIVA），有效地解决了视频数据稀缺和扩散模型微调困难的核心问题。通过将运动学习解耦为专门的、轻量级模块，MIVA实现了对运动模式的精确、可扩展控制，并且避免了复杂的提示工程。这种方法极大地提高了扩散模型在图像动画任务中的效率和实用性，特别是在有限数据和资源（如单个消费级GPU）的约束下。

title: LoFT-LLM: Low-Frequency Time-Series Forecasting with Large Language Models
summary: Time-series forecasting in real-world applications such as finance and energy often faces challenges due to limited training data and complex, noisy temporal dynamics. Existing deep forecasting models typically supervise predictions using full-length temporal windows, which include substantial high-frequency noise and obscure long-term trends. Moreover, auxiliary variables containing rich domain-specific information are often underutilized, especially in few-shot settings. To address these challenges, we propose LoFT-LLM, a frequency-aware forecasting pipeline that integrates low-frequency learning with semantic calibration via a large language model (LLM). Firstly, a Patch Low-Frequency forecasting Module (PLFM) extracts stable low-frequency trends from localized spectral patches. Secondly, a residual learner then models high-frequency variations. Finally, a fine-tuned LLM refines the predictions by incorporating auxiliary context and domain knowledge through structured natural language prompts. Extensive experiments on financial and energy datasets demonstrate that LoFT-LLM significantly outperforms strong baselines under both full-data and few-shot regimes, delivering superior accuracy, robustness, and interpretability.

AI.title_translation: LoFT-LLM：基于大语言模型的低频时间序列预测
AI.tldr: LoFT-LLM是一种新的时间序列预测框架，它通过提取低频趋势（PLFM）并利用微调的大语言模型（LLM）整合辅助信息进行语义校准，显著提高了在数据有限场景下的预测精度和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 解决金融和能源等实际应用中时间序列预测面临的训练数据有限和复杂噪声动态的挑战。现有的深度预测模型通常使用包含大量高频噪声的完整时间窗口进行监督，且在少样本设置中未能充分利用包含领域特定信息的辅助变量。
AI.method: 提出LoFT-LLM，一个频率感知的预测流程，整合了低频学习和通过大语言模型（LLM）进行的语义校准。具体包括：1. 补丁低频预测模块（PLFM）从局部频谱补丁中提取稳定的低频趋势。2. 一个残差学习器建模高频变化。3. 一个微调的LLM通过结构化自然语言提示整合辅助上下文和领域知识来精炼预测。
AI.result: 在金融和能源数据集上的广泛实验表明，LoFT-LLM在全数据和少样本两种情况下均显著优于强大的基线模型，提供了卓越的准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: LoFT-LLM通过结合低频趋势提取和LLM驱动的语义校准，成功解决了时间序列预测中的数据和噪声挑战，并在全数据和少样本设置中均表现出优越的性能。
AI.translation: 在金融和能源等实际应用中，时间序列预测经常面临训练数据有限以及复杂、嘈杂的时间动态带来的挑战。现有的深度预测模型通常使用包含大量高频噪声并掩盖长期趋势的完整时间窗口来监督预测。此外，包含丰富领域特定信息的辅助变量往往未被充分利用，尤其是在少样本设置中。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了LoFT-LLM，这是一个频率感知的预测流程，它通过大语言模型（LLM）将低频学习与语义校准相结合。首先，一个补丁低频预测模块（PLFM）从局部频谱补丁中提取稳定的低频趋势。其次，一个残差学习器对高频变化进行建模。最后，一个微调的LLM通过结构化的自然语言提示整合辅助上下文和领域知识，从而精炼预测结果。在金融和能源数据集上进行的大量实验证明，LoFT-LLM在全数据和少样本两种情况下均显著优于强大的基线模型，提供了卓越的准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LoFT-LLM框架，旨在解决时间序列预测中数据稀疏和高频噪声干扰的问题。LoFT-LLM采用频率感知方法，首先通过PLFM提取稳定的低频趋势，随后使用残差学习器处理高频变化。关键创新在于利用微调的大语言模型，通过自然语言提示整合辅助信息和领域知识（语义校准），以精炼最终预测。实验证明，该方法在金融和能源数据集的少样本和全数据场景中均表现出优越的性能、鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.keywords: 低频预测, 大语言模型, 时间序列, 少样本, 语义校准
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将传统的时间序列频率分解方法（侧重低频趋势）与大语言模型的语义推理能力相结合。利用LLM对辅助变量和领域知识进行结构化提示和预测精炼（语义校准），有效解决了少样本场景下信息利用不足的问题，并提高了模型的鲁棒性和可解释性。这种将LLM作为预测后处理和知识注入工具的范式，对未来时间序列建模具有重要意义。

title: Control Variate Score Matching for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models offer a robust framework for sampling from unnormalized probability densities, which requires accurately estimating the score of the noise-perturbed target distribution. While the standard Denoising Score Identity (DSI) relies on data samples, access to the target energy function enables an alternative formulation via the Target Score Identity (TSI). However, these estimators face a fundamental variance trade-off: DSI exhibits high variance in low-noise regimes, whereas TSI suffers from high variance at high noise levels. In this work, we reconcile these approaches by unifying both estimators within the principled framework of control variates. We introduce the Control Variate Score Identity (CVSI), deriving an optimal, time-dependent control coefficient that theoretically guarantees variance minimization across the entire noise spectrum. We demonstrate that CVSI serves as a robust, low-variance plug-in estimator that significantly enhances sample efficiency in both data-free sampler learning and inference-time diffusion sampling.

AI.title_translation: 扩散模型的控制变量分数匹配
AI.tldr: 本文提出了控制变量分数恒等式（CVSI），通过统一Denoising Score Identity（DSI）和Target Score Identity（TSI），并引入最优控制系数，显著降低了扩散模型在整个噪声范围内的分数估计方差，从而提高了采样效率。
AI.motivation: 标准去噪分数恒等式（DSI）在低噪声状态下表现出高方差，而目标分数恒等式（TSI）在高噪声水平下存在高方差。为了解决这两种估计器固有的方差权衡问题，需要一种更稳健的方法。
AI.method: 本研究通过控制变量的原理框架统一了DSI和TSI两种估计器，并引入了控制变量分数恒等式（CVSI）。该方法推导出一个最优的、时间依赖的控制系数，理论上保证了在整个噪声谱范围内的方差最小化。
AI.result: CVSI作为一个稳健、低方差的即插即用估计器，显著提高了无数据采样器学习和推理时间扩散采样中的样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 控制变量分数恒等式（CVSI）通过结合DSI和TSI的优点，并利用最优控制系数，成功地在整个噪声范围内最小化了分数估计的方差，从而极大地提升了扩散模型的采样效率。
AI.translation: 扩散模型为从非归一化概率密度中采样提供了一个鲁棒的框架，这需要准确估计噪声扰动目标分布的分数。虽然标准的去噪分数恒等式（DSI）依赖于数据样本，但访问目标能量函数可以通过目标分数恒等式（TSI）实现另一种公式。然而，这些估计器面临一个根本的方差权衡：DSI在低噪声状态下表现出高方差，而TSI在高噪声水平下存在高方差。在这项工作中，我们通过在控制变量的原理框架内统一这两种估计器来调和这些方法。我们引入了控制变量分数恒等式（CVSI），推导出一个最优的、时间依赖的控制系数，理论上保证了在整个噪声谱范围内的方差最小化。我们证明了CVSI作为一个稳健、低方差的即插即用估计器，显著提高了无数据采样器学习和推理时间扩散采样中的样本效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了控制变量分数恒等式（CVSI），旨在解决扩散模型中Denoising Score Identity（DSI）和Target Score Identity（TSI）在不同噪声水平下存在的方差问题。通过在控制变量框架下统一DSI和TSI，并推导出一个最优的时间依赖控制系数，CVSI能够理论上最小化整个噪声谱的方差。实验证明，CVSI是一个稳健的低方差估计器，显著提升了无数据采样器学习和推理时间扩散采样的样本效率。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 分数匹配, 控制变量, 方差最小化, 采样效率
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于将控制变量的原理框架引入到扩散模型的分数估计中，巧妙地统一了DSI和TSI，并推导出了一个理论上最优的控制系数。这种方法有效地解决了现有分数估计器在不同噪声水平下的高方差问题，为扩散模型的采样效率和稳定性带来了显著提升，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: IoT-based Android Malware Detection Using Graph Neural Network With Adversarial Defense
summary: Since the Internet of Things (IoT) is widely adopted using Android applications, detecting malicious Android apps is essential. In recent years, Android graph-based deep learning research has proposed many approaches to extract relationships from applications as graphs to generate graph embeddings. First, we demonstrate the effectiveness of graph-based classification using a Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based classifier to generate API graph embeddings. The graph embeddings are combined with Permission and Intent features to train multiple machine learning and deep learning models for Android malware detection. The proposed classification approach achieves an accuracy of 98.33 percent on the CICMaldroid dataset and 98.68 percent on the Drebin dataset. However, graph-based deep learning models are vulnerable, as attackers can add fake relationships to evade detection by the classifier. Second, we propose a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-based attack algorithm named VGAE-MalGAN targeting graph-based GNN Android malware classifiers. The VGAE-MalGAN generator produces adversarial malware API graphs, while the VGAE-MalGAN substitute detector attempts to mimic the target detector. Experimental results show that VGAE-MalGAN can significantly reduce the detection rate of GNN-based malware classifiers. Although the model initially fails to detect adversarial malware, retraining with generated adversarial samples improves robustness and helps mitigate adversarial attacks.

AI.title_translation: 基于物联网的安卓恶意软件检测：使用图神经网络和对抗性防御
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的安卓恶意软件检测方法，并开发了一种名为VGAE-MalGAN的对抗性攻击算法来评估其脆弱性，最终通过对抗性样本再训练提高了模型的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 由于物联网(IoT)广泛采用安卓应用，检测恶意安卓应用至关重要。近年来，基于图的深度学习研究提出了许多方法来从应用中提取关系作为图，以生成图嵌入。
AI.method: 首先，利用图神经网络(GNN)分类器生成API图嵌入，并结合权限和意图特征训练多个机器学习和深度学习模型进行安卓恶意软件检测。其次，提出了一种名为VGAE-MalGAN的生成对抗网络(GAN)攻击算法，专门针对基于图的GNN安卓恶意软件分类器，用于生成对抗性恶意软件API图。最后，通过使用生成的对抗性样本进行再训练来提高模型的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 提出的分类方法在CICMaldroid数据集上达到了98.33%的准确率，在Drebin数据集上达到了98.68%的准确率。VGAE-MalGAN攻击算法能显著降低GNN恶意软件分类器的检测率。通过对抗性样本再训练，模型对对抗性攻击的鲁棒性得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 基于GNN的安卓恶意软件检测方法表现出高准确率，但易受对抗性攻击。通过对抗性训练，可以有效提高模型的鲁棒性，以应对这些攻击。
AI.translation: 由于物联网(IoT)广泛采用安卓应用，检测恶意安卓应用至关重要。近年来，安卓基于图的深度学习研究提出了许多方法来从应用中提取关系作为图以生成图嵌入。首先，我们展示了使用基于图神经网络(GNN)的分类器生成API图嵌入的图基分类的有效性。图嵌入与权限和意图特征相结合，用于训练多个机器学习和深度学习模型进行安卓恶意软件检测。所提出的分类方法在CICMaldroid数据集上达到了98.33%的准确率，在Drebin数据集上达到了98.68%的准确率。然而，基于图的深度学习模型是脆弱的，因为攻击者可以添加虚假关系以逃避分类器的检测。其次，我们提出了一种名为VGAE-MalGAN的生成对抗网络(GAN)攻击算法，专门针对基于图的GNN安卓恶意软件分类器。VGAE-MalGAN生成器生成对抗性恶意软件API图，而VGAE-MalGAN替代检测器试图模仿目标检测器。实验结果表明，VGAE-MalGAN可以显著降低基于GNN的恶意软件分类器的检测率。尽管模型最初未能检测到对抗性恶意软件，但使用生成的对抗性样本进行再训练可以提高鲁棒性，并有助于减轻对抗性攻击。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络(GNN)的安卓恶意软件检测方法，该方法通过生成API图嵌入并结合权限和意图特征进行分类，在多个数据集上取得了高准确率。鉴于GNN模型的脆弱性，作者进一步开发了一种名为VGAE-MalGAN的生成对抗网络攻击算法，成功地降低了GNN分类器的检测率。为增强模型鲁棒性，研究表明使用对抗性样本进行再训练能够有效抵御此类攻击。
AI.keywords: 安卓恶意软件检测, 图神经网络, 对抗性攻击, 物联网, 生成对抗网络
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于不仅提出了高效的基于GNN的安卓恶意软件检测方法，还深入探讨了其对抗性脆弱性，并提出了有效的防御策略。这种攻防结合的研究对于提升实际应用中恶意软件检测系统的安全性具有重要意义。然而，论文未详细说明VGAE-MalGAN在实际复杂环境中的部署挑战和性能。

title: Orthogonal Activation with Implicit Group-Aware Bias Learning for Class Imbalance
summary: Class imbalance is a common challenge in machine learning and data mining, often leading to suboptimal performance in classifiers. While deep learning excels in feature extraction, its performance still deteriorates under imbalanced data. In this work, we propose a novel activation function, named OGAB, designed to alleviate class imbalance in deep learning classifiers. OGAB incorporates orthogonality and group-aware bias learning to enhance feature distinguishability in imbalanced scenarios without explicitly requiring label information. Our key insight is that activation functions can be used to introduce strong inductive biases that can address complex data challenges beyond traditional non-linearity. Our work demonstrates that orthogonal transformations can preserve information about minority classes by maintaining feature independence, thereby preventing the dominance of majority classes in the embedding space. Further, the proposed group-aware bias mechanism automatically identifies data clusters and adjusts embeddings to enhance class separability without the need for explicit supervision. Unlike existing approaches that address class imbalance through preprocessing data modifications or post-processing corrections, our proposed approach tackles class imbalance during the training phase at the embedding learning level, enabling direct integration with the learning process. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our solution on both real-world and synthetic imbalanced datasets, showing consistent performance improvements over both traditional and learnable activation functions.

AI.title_translation: 用于类别不平衡的正交激活与隐式组感知偏置学习
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为OGAB的新型激活函数，通过引入正交性和组感知偏置学习来解决深度学习中的类别不平衡问题，无需显式标签信息，并在嵌入学习层面直接提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 类别不平衡是机器学习中的一个常见挑战，会导致分类器性能不佳，即使是深度学习模型在不平衡数据下性能也会下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为OGAB的新型激活函数，该函数结合了正交性和组感知偏置学习。正交变换用于保持特征独立性，防止多数类主导嵌入空间。组感知偏置机制自动识别数据簇并调整嵌入以增强类别可分性，无需显式监督。该方法在训练阶段的嵌入学习层面解决类别不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在真实世界和合成不平衡数据集上均取得了性能提升，并且优于传统的和可学习的激活函数。
AI.conclusion: OGAB激活函数通过正交性和组感知偏置学习，在不平衡数据集上有效提升了深度学习分类器的性能，证明了激活函数在解决复杂数据挑战方面的潜力。
AI.translation: 类别不平衡是机器学习和数据挖掘中一个常见的挑战，经常导致分类器性能不佳。尽管深度学习在特征提取方面表现出色，但在不平衡数据下其性能仍然会下降。在本研究中，我们提出了一种名为OGAB的新型激活函数，旨在缓解深度学习分类器中的类别不平衡问题。OGAB结合了正交性和组感知偏置学习，以增强在不平衡场景下的特征可辨性，而无需显式标签信息。我们的关键见解是，激活函数可用于引入强大的归纳偏置，以解决传统非线性之外的复杂数据挑战。我们的研究表明，正交变换可以通过保持特征独立性来保留少数类的相关信息，从而防止多数类在嵌入空间中占据主导地位。此外，提出的组感知偏置机制能够自动识别数据簇并调整嵌入以增强类别可分性，而无需显式监督。与现有的通过预处理数据修改或后处理校正来解决类别不平衡问题的方法不同，我们提出的方法在嵌入学习层面、训练阶段直接解决类别不平衡问题，从而能够与学习过程直接集成。我们在真实世界和合成的不平衡数据集上证明了我们解决方案的有效性，并显示出与传统和可学习激活函数相比，性能持续提升。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为OGAB的新型激活函数，旨在解决深度学习中的类别不平衡问题。OGAB通过引入正交变换和组感知偏置学习机制，在嵌入学习层面增强特征区分能力，而无需显式标签信息。该方法通过保持特征独立性来保护少数类信息，并通过自动调整嵌入来提高类别可分性。与现有方法不同，OGAB在训练阶段直接作用于嵌入学习，易于集成。实验结果表明，OGAB在真实和合成数据集上均优于传统和可学习激活函数。
AI.keywords: 类别不平衡, 激活函数, 正交性, 组感知偏置, 嵌入学习
AI.comments: 这项工作提出了一种新颖的激活函数OGAB，它通过结合正交性和组感知偏置学习来解决深度学习中的类别不平衡问题。该方法的一个关键优势在于它在嵌入学习层面直接解决问题，而不是依赖于数据预处理或后处理技术，这使得它更容易与现有模型集成。此外，该方法无需显式标签信息即可工作，这在许多实际应用中可能是一个重要的优势。然而，该方法的计算复杂性以及在不同类型的不平衡数据集上的泛化能力仍有待进一步研究。

title: PaveSync: A Unified and Comprehensive Dataset for Pavement Distress Analysis and Classification
summary: Automated pavement defect detection often struggles to generalize across diverse real-world conditions due to the lack of standardized datasets. Existing datasets differ in annotation styles, distress type definitions, and formats, limiting their integration for unified training. To address this gap, we introduce a comprehensive benchmark dataset that consolidates multiple publicly available sources into a standardized collection of 52747 images from seven countries, with 135277 bounding box annotations covering 13 distinct distress types. The dataset captures broad real-world variation in image quality, resolution, viewing angles, and weather conditions, offering a unique resource for consistent training and evaluation. Its effectiveness was demonstrated through benchmarking with state-of-the-art object detection models including YOLOv8-YOLOv12, Faster R-CNN, and DETR, which achieved competitive performance across diverse scenarios. By standardizing class definitions and annotation formats, this dataset provides the first globally representative benchmark for pavement defect detection and enables fair comparison of models, including zero-shot transfer to new environments.

AI.title_translation: PaveSync：用于路面病害分析和分类的统一且全面的数据集
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建了PaveSync，一个前所未有的、标准化的全球路面病害数据集（52747张图，13种病害），以克服现有数据集不一致的障碍，并在SOTA模型上验证了其有效性，以促进公平的性能评估和零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动化路面缺陷检测方法难以在多样化的真实世界条件下泛化，原因是缺乏标准化的数据集，现有数据集在标注风格、病害类型定义和格式上存在差异，阻碍了统一训练。
AI.method: 整合了多个公开来源，创建了一个包含52747张图像和135277个边界框标注的标准化数据集，涵盖13种不同的病害类型。然后使用YOLOv8-YOLOv12、Faster R-CNN和DETR等最先进的目标检测模型进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 该数据集捕获了图像质量、分辨率、视角和天气条件的广泛真实变化。使用最先进的目标检测模型（如YOLOv8-YOLOv12、Faster R-CNN和DETR）进行的基准测试表明，模型在多样化场景中实现了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过标准化类别定义和标注格式，该数据集首次提供了具有全球代表性的路面缺陷检测基准，并支持公平的模型比较，包括向新环境的零样本迁移。
AI.translation: 自动路面缺陷检测通常难以在多样化的现实世界条件下泛化，原因在于缺乏标准化数据集。现有数据集在标注风格、病害类型定义和格式上存在差异，限制了它们进行统一训练的整合。为解决这一差距，我们引入了一个全面的基准数据集，它整合了多个公开可用的来源，形成了一个标准化的合集，包含来自七个国家的52747张图像，以及覆盖13种不同病害类型的135277个边界框标注。该数据集捕获了图像质量、分辨率、视角和天气条件的广泛真实变化，为一致的训练和评估提供了一个独特的资源。通过使用包括YOLOv8-YOLOv12、Faster R-CNN和DETR在内的最先进目标检测模型的基准测试证明了其有效性，这些模型在多样化场景中取得了具有竞争力的性能。通过标准化类别定义和标注格式，该数据集为路面缺陷检测提供了第一个具有全球代表性的基准，并实现了模型的公平比较，包括向新环境的零样本迁移。
AI.summary: PaveSync是一个统一且全面的路面病害分析数据集，旨在解决现有数据集不统一的问题。它整合了来自七个国家的52747张图像和135277个标注，涵盖13种病害类型，并捕获了广泛的真实世界变化。通过对SOTA模型的基准测试，该数据集被证明是首个具有全球代表性的基准，支持一致的训练和公平的模型比较。
AI.keywords: 路面病害分析, 统一数据集, 基准测试, 目标检测, 零样本迁移
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于创建了一个统一、全面的路面病害分析数据集PaveSync，解决了现有数据集不统一、难以整合的问题。其重要性在于提供了首个具有全球代表性的基准，促进了模型的一致性训练和公平比较，并展示了其在零样本迁移方面的潜力。局限性可能在于它依赖于现有公开数据集的整合，可能继承了原始数据的某些局限性。

title: SegEarth-R2: Towards Comprehensive Language-guided Segmentation for Remote Sensing Images
summary: Effectively grounding complex language to pixels in remote sensing (RS) images is a critical challenge for applications like disaster response and environmental monitoring. Current models can parse simple, single-target commands but fail when presented with complex geospatial scenarios, e.g., segmenting objects at various granularities, executing multi-target instructions, and interpreting implicit user intent. To drive progress against these failures, we present LaSeRS, the first large-scale dataset built for comprehensive training and evaluation across four critical dimensions of language-guided segmentation: hierarchical granularity, target multiplicity, reasoning requirements, and linguistic variability. By capturing these dimensions, LaSeRS moves beyond simple commands, providing a benchmark for complex geospatial reasoning. This addresses a critical gap: existing datasets oversimplify, leading to sensitivity-prone real-world models. We also propose SegEarth-R2, an MLLM architecture designed for comprehensive language-guided segmentation in RS, which directly confronts these challenges. The model's effectiveness stems from two key improvements: (1) a spatial attention supervision mechanism specifically handles the localization of small objects and their components, and (2) a flexible and efficient segmentation query mechanism that handles both single-target and multi-target scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that our SegEarth-R2 achieves outstanding performance on LaSeRS and other benchmarks, establishing a powerful baseline for the next generation of geospatial segmentation. All data and code will be released at https://github.com/earth-insights/SegEarth-R2.

AI.title_translation: SegEarth-R2：迈向遥感图像全面语言引导分割
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了SegEarth-R2模型和LaSeRS数据集，用于解决遥感图像中复杂的语言引导分割问题，并在多个维度上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在处理遥感图像中的复杂语言引导分割任务时存在不足，尤其是在处理多目标、多粒度、隐含意图等场景时。
AI.method: 提出了SegEarth-R2模型，包含空间注意力监督机制和灵活高效的分割查询机制，并构建了LaSeRS数据集来全面训练和评估模型。
AI.result: SegEarth-R2在LaSeRS和其他基准测试中取得了优异的性能，为下一代地理空间分割设定了标准。
AI.conclusion: SegEarth-R2模型和LaSeRS数据集能够有效地处理遥感图像中复杂的语言引导分割任务，弥补了现有方法的不足。
AI.translation: 有效将复杂的语言与遥感（RS）图像中的像素对应起来，对于灾难响应和环境监测等应用至关重要。当前模型可以解析简单的、单一目标指令，但在面对复杂的地理空间场景时会失败，例如分割不同粒度的对象、执行多目标指令以及解释用户隐含意图。为了推动克服这些失败，我们提出了LaSeRS，这是第一个大规模数据集，用于在四个关键的语言引导分割维度上进行全面训练和评估：层次粒度、目标多重性、推理要求和语言变异性。通过捕捉这些维度，LaSeRS超越了简单的指令，为复杂的地理空间推理提供了基准。这解决了关键的差距：现有数据集过于简化，导致现实世界模型对敏感性过于敏感。我们还提出了SegEarth-R2，一个针对RS中全面语言引导分割而设计的MLLM架构，直接应对这些挑战。该模型的有效性源于两个关键改进：（1）空间注意力监督机制专门处理小目标及其组件的定位，以及（2）灵活高效的分割查询机制处理单目标和多目标场景。实验结果表明，我们的SegEarth-R2在LaSeRS和其他基准测试中取得了出色的性能，为下一代地理空间分割奠定了强大的基础。所有数据和代码将在https://github.com/earth-insights/SegEarth-R2发布。
AI.summary: SegEarth-R2是一个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）架构，旨在解决遥感图像中的复杂语言引导分割问题。它通过引入空间注意力监督机制来改进小目标及其组件的定位，并通过灵活高效的分割查询机制来处理单目标和多目标场景。该研究还发布了LaSeRS数据集，这是首个用于训练和评估语言引导分割在层次粒度、目标多重性、推理要求和语言变异性四个关键维度上表现的大规模数据集。实验证明SegEarth-R2在LaSeRS及其他基准测试中表现优异。
AI.keywords: 语言引导分割, 遥感图像, 多模态大语言模型, 注意力机制, 地理空间推理
AI.comments: SegEarth-R2在解决遥感图像复杂语言引导分割问题上取得了显著进展，通过引入新的数据集和模型架构，有效提升了模型处理多目标、多粒度和隐含意图等复杂场景的能力。其空间注意力机制和灵活的查询机制是模型成功的关键。然而，模型在处理极端复杂或模糊指令时的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Bring My Cup! Personalizing Vision-Language-Action Models with Visual Attentive Prompting
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize well to generic instructions, they struggle with personalized commands such as "bring my cup", where the robot must act on one specific instance among visually similar objects. We study this setting of manipulating personal objects, in which a VLA must identify and control a user-specific object unseen during training using only a few reference images. To address this challenge, we propose Visual Attentive Prompting (VAP), a simple-yet-effective training-free perceptual adapter that equips frozen VLAs with top-down selective attention. VAP treats the reference images as a non-parametric visual memory, grounds the personal object in the scene through open-vocabulary detection and embedding-based matching, and then injects this grounding as a visual prompt by highlighting the object and rewriting the instruction. We construct two simulation benchmarks, Personalized-SIMPLER and Personalized-VLABench, and a real-world tabletop benchmark to evaluate personalized manipulation across multiple robots and tasks. Experiments show that VAP consistently outperforms generic policies and token-learning baselines in both success rate and correct-object manipulation, helping to bridge the gap between semantic understanding and instance-level control.

AI.title_translation: 拿我的杯子！通过视觉注意力提示个性化视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.tldr: 针对VLA模型难以执行“拿我的杯子”这类个性化指令的问题，本文提出了VAP，一个无需训练的视觉适配器，它通过将参考图作为记忆、定位特定物体并将其作为视觉提示注入到冻结模型中，成功实现了对用户特定实例的准确操作。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在处理“拿我的杯子”这类需要区分视觉上相似的特定实例的个性化指令时表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出视觉注意力提示（VAP），一个训练免费的感知适配器，它将参考图像视为非参数视觉记忆，通过开放词汇检测和基于嵌入的匹配来定位场景中的个人物体，然后通过高亮显示物体和重写指令的方式将这种定位作为视觉提示注入到冻结的VLA模型中。
AI.result: VAP在两个仿真基准（Personalized-SIMPLER和Personalized-VLABench）和一个真实世界桌面基准上，在成功率和正确物体操作方面持续优于通用策略和Token学习基线。
AI.conclusion: VAP在成功率和正确物体操作方面持续优于通用策略和Token学习基线，有助于弥合语义理解和实例级控制之间的差距。
AI.translation: 尽管视觉语言动作（VLA）模型对通用指令具有良好的泛化能力，但在“拿我的杯子”等个性化指令上表现不佳，机器人必须在一个视觉上相似的对象中识别并操作用户特定的一个实例。我们研究了这种操纵个人物体的场景，其中VLA必须仅使用少量参考图像来识别和控制一个在训练期间未见过的用户特定对象。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了视觉注意力提示（VAP），一个简单而有效的训练免费感知适配器，它为冻结的VLA配备了自上而下的选择性注意力。VAP将参考图像视为非参数视觉记忆，通过开放词汇检测和基于嵌入的匹配来定位场景中的个人物体，然后通过高亮显示物体和重写指令的方式将这种定位作为视觉提示注入。我们构建了两个仿真基准Personalized-SIMPLER和Personalized-VLABench，以及一个真实世界的桌面基准，以评估跨多个机器人和任务的个性化操作。实验表明，VAP在成功率和正确物体操作方面持续优于通用策略和Token学习基线，有助于弥合语义理解和实例级控制之间的差距。
AI.summary: 为了解决VLA模型在处理需要识别和控制训练中未见过的用户特定对象（如“我的杯子”）的个性化指令方面的挑战，本文提出了视觉注意力提示（VAP）。VAP是一种训练免费的感知适配器，它利用参考图像作为视觉记忆，通过开放词汇检测和嵌入匹配定位目标实例，并将该定位信息作为视觉提示注入到冻结的VLA模型中，从而实现了对特定实例的精确操作。
AI.keywords: 个性化操作, 视觉语言动作模型, 视觉注意力提示, 训练免费适配器, 实例级控制
AI.comments: 该方法（VAP）的创新之处在于其“训练免费”的特性，它通过将参考图像视为非参数视觉记忆，并利用开放词汇检测和基于嵌入的匹配来高效地将个人对象的定位信息作为视觉提示注入到冻结的VLA模型中，实现了对特定实例的精确控制，这在解决通用模型对个性化指令的局限性方面具有重要意义。

title: HeylandCircle: A Computational Framework for the Geometric Reconstruction of the Heyland Circle Diagram
summary: The Heyland circle diagram is a classical graphical tool for representing the steady-state behavior of induction machines using no-load and blocked-rotor test data. While widely used in alternating-current machinery texts, the diagram is typically presented as a hand-constructed aid and lacks a standardized computational formulation. This paper presents HeylandCircle, a computational framework that reconstructs the classical Heyland circle diagram directly from standard test parameters. The framework formalizes the traditional geometric construction as a deterministic, reproducible sequence of geometric operations, establishing a clear mapping between measured data, fixed geometric objects, and steady-state operating points. Quantities such as power factor, slip, output power, torque, and efficiency are obtained through explicit geometric relationships on the constructed diagram. Validation using a representative textbook example demonstrates close agreement with classical results. The framework provides a computational realization of the traditional Heyland diagram suitable for instruction, analysis, and systematic extension.

AI.title_translation: HeylandCircle：海兰圆图几何重建的计算框架
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建了一个名为HeylandCircle的计算工具，用于将经典的、手工绘制的海兰圆图（用于感应电机分析）自动化和标准化，可以直接从测试数据重建图表并计算性能参数。
AI.motivation: 传统的Heyland圆图通常作为手工构建的辅助工具，缺乏标准化的计算公式。
AI.method: 将传统的几何构造形式化为一系列确定性的、可重复的几何操作，直接从标准试验参数重建海兰圆图。
AI.result: 使用一个代表性的教科书示例进行验证，结果与经典结果非常吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为传统海兰图提供了一个计算实现，适用于教学、分析和系统性扩展。
AI.translation: 海兰圆图是使用空载和堵转试验数据表示感应电机稳态行为的经典图形工具。尽管在交流电机教科书中被广泛使用，但该图通常被呈现为手工构建的辅助工具，缺乏标准化的计算公式。本文提出了HeylandCircle，一个计算框架，可以直接从标准测试参数重建经典的Heyland圆图。该框架将传统的几何构造形式化为确定性的、可重复的几何操作序列，在测量数据、固定几何对象和稳态工作点之间建立了清晰的映射关系。诸如功率因数、滑差、输出功率、转矩和效率等量，是通过构建图上的显式几何关系获得的。使用一个代表性的教科书示例进行验证，结果与经典结果非常吻合。该框架为传统的Heyland图提供了一个计算实现，适用于教学、分析和系统性扩展。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为HeylandCircle的计算框架，用于直接从标准测试参数重建经典的Heyland圆图。该框架将传统的手工几何构造形式化为确定性的计算步骤，从而将测量数据与稳态工作点建立明确的映射关系，并能通过图上的显式几何关系获取功率因数、转矩等关键参数。
AI.keywords: 海兰圆图, 感应电机, 计算框架, 几何重建, 稳态分析
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将经典的、通常手工绘制的海兰圆图转化为一个标准化的、可计算的框架，使其具有确定性和可重复性。其重要性在于为交流电机稳态分析提供了一个现代化的、基于计算的工具。局限性在于其应用范围目前仅限于海兰圆图的重建，尚未展示其在更复杂的电机模型或动态分析中的潜力。

title: Scaling Point-based Differentiable Rendering for Large-scale Reconstruction
summary: Point-based Differentiable Rendering (PBDR) enables high-fidelity 3D scene reconstruction, but scaling PBDR to high-resolution and large scenes requires efficient distributed training systems. Existing systems are tightly coupled to a specific PBDR method. And they suffer from severe communication overhead due to poor data locality. In this paper, we present Gaian, a general distributed training system for PBDR. Gaian provides a unified API expressive enough to support existing PBDR methods, while exposing rich data-access information, which Gaian leverages to optimize locality and reduce communication. We evaluated Gaian by implementing 4 PBDR algorithms. Our implementations achieve high performance and resource efficiency: across six datasets and up to 128 GPUs, it reduces communication by up to 91% and improves training throughput by 1.50x-3.71x.

AI.title_translation: 点渲染可微渲染大规模重建的扩展
AI.tldr: 为了让点渲染可微渲染（PBDR）能处理大规模场景，研究人员开发了一个名为Gaian的通用分布式训练系统。Gaian通过优化数据访问和减少通信，使得PBDR的训练速度更快、资源利用率更高，在实验中性能提升显著。
AI.motivation: 点渲染可微渲染（PBDR）可以实现高保真3D场景重建，但将其扩展到高分辨率和大规模场景需要高效的分布式训练系统。现有系统与特定PBDR方法耦合紧密，并且由于数据局部性差而遭受严重的通信开销。
AI.method: 提出Gaian，一个通用的分布式训练系统，它提供了一个统一的API来支持现有的PBDR方法，并利用暴露出的丰富数据访问信息来优化数据局部性并减少通信开销。
AI.result: 在六个数据集和多达128个GPU上，Gaian的实现将通信量减少了高达91%，并将训练吞吐量提高了1.50倍到3.71倍。
AI.conclusion: Gaian在四个PBDR算法的实现中展示了高性能和资源效率，在不同数据集和多达128个GPU上，通信量减少了91%，训练吞吐量提高了1.50倍到3.71倍。
AI.translation: 点渲染可微渲染（PBDR）能够实现高保真3D场景重建，但将PBDR扩展到高分辨率和大规模场景需要高效的分布式训练系统。现有系统与特定的PBDR方法紧密耦合，并且由于数据局部性差而遭受严重的通信开销。在本文中，我们提出了Gaian，一个通用的PBDR分布式训练系统。Gaian提供了一个足够丰富的统一API来支持现有的PBDR方法，同时暴露了丰富的数据访问信息，Gaian利用这些信息来优化局部性和减少通信。我们通过实现4种PBDR算法来评估Gaian。我们的实现实现了高性能和资源效率：在六个数据集和多达128个GPU上，它将通信量减少了高达91%，并将训练吞吐量提高了1.50倍到3.71倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Gaian，一个通用的分布式训练系统，旨在解决点渲染可微渲染（PBDR）在大规模场景重建中面临的效率和通信开销问题。Gaian提供统一API以兼容现有PBDR方法，并通过优化数据局部性来显著减少通信，从而提高了训练性能和资源效率。
AI.keywords: 点渲染可微渲染, 分布式训练系统, 数据局部性, 通信开销, 大规模重建
AI.comments: Gaian的创新之处在于提供了一个通用的、足够灵活的API来支持现有的PBDR方法，同时通过暴露数据访问信息来优化数据局部性和减少通信开销，解决了现有系统耦合性强和通信开销大的问题。其重要性在于为大规模点渲染可微渲染的分布式训练提供了一个高效的通用框架。局限性在于摘要中没有提及。

title: A hybrid global local computational framework for ship hull structural analysis using homogenized model and graph neural network
summary: This study presents a computational framework for global local structural analysis of ship hull girders that integrates an equivalent single layer (ESL) model with a graph neural network (GNN). A coarse mesh homogenized ESL model efficiently predicts the global displacement field, from which degrees of freedom (DOFs) along stiffened panel boundaries are extracted. A global to local DOF mapping and reconstruction procedure is developed to recover detailed boundary kinematics for local analysis. The reconstructed DOFs, together with panel geometry and loading, serve as inputs to a heterogeneous graph transformer (HGT), a subtype of GNN, which rapidly and accurately predicts the detailed stress and displacement fields for any panel within the hull girder. The HGT is trained using high fidelity 3D panel finite element model with reconstructed boundary conditions, enabling it to generalize across varying panel geometries, loadings, and boundary behaviors. Once trained, the framework requires only the global ESL solution in order to generate detailed local responses, making it highly suitable for optimization. Validation on three box beam case studies demonstrates that the global prediction error is governed by the coarse mesh ESL solution, while the HGT maintains high local accuracy and clearly outperforms conventional ESL based stress estimation method.

AI.title_translation: 一种结合均匀化模型和图神经网络的船舶结构分析混合全局-局部计算框架
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个结合粗网格ESL模型和图神经网络（HGT）的混合方法，用于船舶结构分析。ESL提供全局位移，HGT基于此快速预测精确的局部应力和位移，比传统ESL方法准确得多，非常适合优化。
AI.motivation: 开发一种能够高效且准确地进行船体梁全局-局部结构分析的计算框架，以支持优化设计。
AI.method: 提出一个计算框架，首先使用粗网格均匀化等效单层（ESL）模型预测全局位移场，然后提取边界自由度（DOFs）并进行重构，将重构的DOFs、面板几何和载荷作为输入，送入异构图Transformer（HGT，一种GNN）中，以快速准确地预测详细的局部应力和位移场。HGT使用高保真3D面板有限元模型进行训练。
AI.result: 全局预测误差由粗网格ESL解控制，而HGT保持了高局部精度，并且其性能明显优于传统的基于ESL的应力估计方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的混合框架（ESL模型与HGT结合）能够基于全局ESL解快速准确地预测详细的局部应力和位移场，验证结果表明HGT在保持高局部精度的同时，明显优于传统的基于ESL的应力估计方法。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了一种集成等效单层（ESL）模型和图神经网络（GNN）的船体梁全局-局部结构分析计算框架。粗网格均匀化ESL模型能有效预测全局位移场，并从中提取加强板边界处的自由度（DOFs）。开发了一种全局到局部DOF的映射和重构程序，以恢复局部分析所需的详细边界运动学。重构的DOFs与面板几何和载荷一起作为异构图Transformer（HGT，GNN的一种子类型）的输入，该网络能快速准确地预测船体梁内任何面板的详细应力和位移场。HGT使用具有重构边界条件的3D面板有限元模型进行训练，使其能够泛化到变化的面板几何、载荷和边界行为。一旦训练完成，该框架仅需要全局ESL解即可生成详细的局部响应，使其高度适用于优化。对三个箱梁案例研究的验证表明，全局预测误差受限于粗网格ESL解，而HGT保持了高局部精度，并且明显优于传统的基于ESL的应力估计方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种集成等效单层（ESL）模型和图神经网络（GNN）的混合计算框架，用于船体梁的全局-局部结构分析。该框架首先用ESL模型获得全局解，然后重构边界运动学作为输入，驱动异构图Transformer（HGT）快速准确地预测详细的局部应力和位移场。训练后的模型仅需全局ESL解即可生成局部响应，适用于优化。测试结果表明该方法具有高局部精度。
AI.keywords: 混合框架, 船体结构分析, 等效单层模型, 图神经网络, 全局-局部分析
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将传统的均匀化模型（ESL）与先进的图神经网络（HGT）相结合，形成一个高效的混合框架，用于解决船舶结构分析中的全局-局部耦合问题。其重要性在于实现了快速、高精度的局部响应预测，尤其适用于优化设计。局限性在于GNN的训练依赖于高保真3D FEM结果。

title: LLM-Assisted Abstract Screening with OLIVER: Evaluating Calibration and Single-Model vs. Actor-Critic Configurations in Literature Reviews
summary:
Introduction: Recent work suggests large language models (LLMs) can accelerate screening, but prior evaluations focus on earlier LLMs, standardized Cochrane reviews, single-model setups, and accuracy as the primary metric, leaving generalizability, configuration effects, and calibration largely unexamined.
  Methods: We developed OLIVER (Optimized LLM-based Inclusion and Vetting Engine for Reviews), an open-source pipeline for LLM-assisted abstract screening. We evaluated multiple contemporary LLMs across two non-Cochrane systematic reviews and performance was assessed at both the full-text screening and final inclusion stages using accuracy, AUC, and calibration metrics. We further tested an actor-critic screening framework combining two lightweight models under three aggregation rules.
  Results: Across individual models, performance varied widely. In the smaller Review 1 (821 abstracts, 63 final includes), several models achieved high sensitivity for final includes but at the cost of substantial false positives and poor calibration. In the larger Review 2 (7741 abstracts, 71 final includes), most models were highly specific but struggled to recover true includes, with prompt design influencing recall. Calibration was consistently weak across single-model configurations despite high overall accuracy. Actor-critic screening improved discrimination and markedly reduced calibration error in both reviews, yielding higher AUCs.
  Discussion: LLMs may eventually accelerate abstract screening, but single-model performance is highly sensitive to review characteristics, prompting, and calibration is limited. An actor-critic framework improves classification quality and confidence reliability while remaining computationally efficient, enabling large-scale screening at low cost.

AI.title_translation: OLIVER：评估LLM辅助摘要筛选中的校准性以及单模型与Actor-Critic配置在文献综述中的表现
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了OLIVER工具和Actor-Critic框架来评估和改进当前LLM在摘要筛选中的表现。结果表明，虽然单个LLM表现不稳定且校准性差，但Actor-Critic方法通过提高AUC和降低校准误差，提供了更可靠、计算效率高的解决方案，有望加速文献综述。
AI.motivation: 以往对LLM辅助筛选的评估主要集中在较早的LLM、标准化的Cochrane综述、单模型设置以及准确性作为主要指标上，忽略了通用性、配置效应和校准性等关键方面。
AI.method: 开发了开源流程OLIVER（优化的LLM辅助纳入和审查引擎），评估了多个当代LLM在两个非Cochrane系统综述中的性能（使用准确性、AUC和校准指标），并测试了一个结合两个轻量级模型的Actor-Critic筛选框架，该框架在三种聚合规则下运行。
AI.result: 单个模型性能差异很大；在较小的综述中，高召回率伴随着大量假阳性和校准不佳；在较大的综述中，模型特异性高但难以召回真实纳入项，提示设计影响召回率。所有单模型配置的校准性普遍较弱。Actor-Critic筛选在两个综述中都提高了区分度和显著降低了校准误差，获得了更高的AUC。
AI.conclusion: LLM有潜力加速摘要筛选，但单模型性能对综述特性和提示设计非常敏感，且校准性较差。Actor-Critic框架通过提高分类质量和置信度可靠性，同时保持计算效率，从而改进了摘要筛选，适用于大规模筛选。
AI.translation:
引言：最近的工作表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）可以加速筛选过程，但先前的评估侧重于早期的LLM、标准化的Cochrane综述、单模型设置以及将准确性作为主要指标，留下了通用性、配置效应和校准性在很大程度上未经检验。
方法：我们开发了OLIVER（优化的LLM辅助纳入和审查引擎），一个用于LLM辅助摘要筛选的开源流程。我们评估了多个当代LLM在两个非Cochrane系统综述中的表现，并在全文筛选和最终纳入阶段使用准确性、AUC和校准指标评估了性能。我们进一步测试了一个Actor-Critic筛选框架，该框架结合了两个轻量级模型，并使用了三种聚合规则。
结果：在各个模型中，性能差异很大。在较小的综述1（821篇摘要，63篇最终纳入）中，一些模型实现了高召回率以纳入最终结果，但代价是大量的假阳性和校准性不佳。在较大的综述2（7741篇摘要，71篇最终纳入）中，大多数模型具有高度特异性，但在召回真实纳入项方面遇到困难，提示设计影响了召回率。尽管整体准确性很高，但所有单模型配置的校准性始终较弱。Actor-Critic筛选在两个综述中都提高了区分度并显著降低了校准误差，获得了更高的AUC。
讨论：LLM最终可能加速摘要筛选，但单模型性能对综述特性高度敏感，且校准性受到限制。Actor-Critic框架在保持计算效率的同时，提高了分类质量和置信度可靠性，从而能够以低成本进行大规模筛选。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了OLIVER，一个用于LLM辅助摘要筛选的开源流程，旨在克服先前研究对早期LLM、Cochrane综述和准确性指标的关注局限。研究评估了当代LLM在非Cochrane综述中的性能，并测试了Actor-Critic框架。结果显示，单模型性能差异大且校准性差，而Actor-Critic框架显著提高了区分度和校准可靠性，为高效、可靠的大规模文献筛选提供了一个有前景的解决方案。
AI.keywords: LLM, 摘要筛选, OLIVER, 校准, Actor-Critic
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于评估了当前先进的LLM在非Cochrane综述中的通用性、校准性，并引入了Actor-Critic框架来解决单模型配置的局限性，这超越了以往仅关注准确性和标准化综述的评估。其重要性在于为大规模、低成本的文献筛选提供了一个更可靠、校准性更好的解决方案。局限性在于，即使在Actor-Critic配置下，单一模型的性能仍然高度依赖于综述的特性和提示设计。

title: A Contextual Analysis of Driver-Facing and Dual-View Video Inputs for Distraction Detection in Naturalistic Driving Environments
summary: Despite increasing interest in computer vision-based distracted driving detection, most existing models rely exclusively on driver-facing views and overlook crucial environmental context that influences driving behavior. This study investigates whether incorporating road-facing views alongside driver-facing footage improves distraction detection accuracy in naturalistic driving conditions. Using synchronized dual-camera recordings from real-world driving, we benchmark three leading spatiotemporal action recognition architectures: SlowFast-R50, X3D-M, and SlowOnly-R50. Each model is evaluated under two input configurations: driver-only and stacked dual-view. Results show that while contextual inputs can improve detection in certain models, performance gains depend strongly on the underlying architecture. The single-pathway SlowOnly model achieved a 9.8 percent improvement with dual-view inputs, while the dual-pathway SlowFast model experienced a 7.2 percent drop in accuracy due to representational conflicts. These findings suggest that simply adding visual context is not sufficient and may lead to interference unless the architecture is specifically designed to support multi-view integration. This study presents one of the first systematic comparisons of single- and dual-view distraction detection models using naturalistic driving data and underscores the importance of fusion-aware design for future multimodal driver monitoring systems.

AI.title_translation: 驾驶员面向和双视图视频输入的上下文分析在自然驾驶环境中用于分心检测
AI.tldr: 在自然驾驶环境中，结合道路视角和驾驶员视角可以提高分心检测的准确性，但效果取决于模型架构。
AI.motivation: 现有基于计算机视觉的分心驾驶检测模型大多仅依赖驾驶员视角，忽略了影响驾驶行为的关键环境背景信息，因此本研究旨在探讨结合道路视角和驾驶员视角能否提高自然驾驶条件下分心检测的准确性。
AI.method: 使用同步的双摄像头自然驾驶录像，对三种领先的时空动作识别架构（SlowFast-R50、X3D-M 和 SlowOnly-R50）进行了基准测试。评估了两种输入配置：仅驾驶员视角和堆叠的双视图。
AI.result: 结果表明，虽然上下文输入可以提高某些模型的检测性能，但性能增益在很大程度上取决于底层架构。单路径 SlowOnly 模型在使用双视图输入时准确率提高了 9.8%，而双路径 SlowFast 模型由于表示冲突，准确率下降了 7.2%。
AI.conclusion: 简单地添加视觉上下文并不足以提高分心检测的准确性，甚至可能导致干扰，除非模型架构经过专门设计以支持多视图集成。未来的多模态驾驶员监控系统需要融合感知设计。
AI.translation: 尽管基于计算机视觉的分心驾驶检测越来越受到关注，但大多数现有模型仅依赖于面向驾驶员的视图，而忽略了影响驾驶行为的关键环境背景。本研究调查了在自然驾驶条件下，将面向道路的视图与面向驾驶员的镜头结合起来是否可以提高分心检测的准确性。我们使用真实驾驶的同步双摄像头录像，对三种领先的时空动作识别架构：SlowFast-R50、X3D-M 和 SlowOnly-R50 进行了基准测试。在两种输入配置下评估了每种模型：仅面向驾驶员的视图和堆叠的双视图。结果表明，虽然上下文输入可以提高某些模型的检测性能，但性能增益在很大程度上取决于底层架构。单路径 SlowOnly 模型在使用双视图输入时准确率提高了 9.8%，而双路径 SlowFast 模型由于表示冲突，准确率下降了 7.2%。这些发现表明，简单地添加视觉上下文并不足以提高检测性能，除非模型架构经过专门设计以支持多视图集成。本研究对使用自然驾驶数据对单视图和双视图分心检测模型进行了首次系统性比较，并强调了融合感知设计对于未来多模态驾驶员监控系统的重要性。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了在自然驾驶环境中，结合驾驶员视角和道路视角信息对分心检测准确性的影响。研究人员使用三种不同的时空动作识别模型（SlowFast-R50、X3D-M、SlowOnly-R50）在仅驾驶员视角和双视图（驾驶员+道路）两种输入模式下进行了测试。结果显示，双视图输入的有效性高度依赖于模型架构：单路径的 SlowOnly 模型准确率提升了 9.8%，而双路径的 SlowFast 模型准确率反而下降了 7.2%。这表明，简单地增加数据源并不总能带来性能提升，模型需要具备融合多视图信息的能力。本研究强调了在设计未来的多模态驾驶员监控系统时，融合感知设计的重要性。
AI.keywords: 分心检测, 自然驾驶, 多模态融合, 驾驶员监控, 计算机视觉
AI.comments: 该研究首次系统地比较了在自然驾驶数据上使用单视图和双视图分心检测模型，并强调了融合感知设计在未来多模态驾驶员监控系统中的重要性。研究结果具有实际意义，可以指导未来驾驶员监控系统的设计。

title: MAPI-GNN: Multi-Activation Plane Interaction Graph Neural Network for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
comments: Accepted by Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 40 (AAAI-26)
summary: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to multimodal medical diagnosis for their inherent relational modeling capabilities. However, their efficacy is often compromised by the prevailing reliance on a single, static graph built from indiscriminate features, hindering the ability to model patient-specific pathological relationships. To this end, the proposed Multi-Activation Plane Interaction Graph Neural Network (MAPI-GNN) reconstructs this single-graph paradigm by learning a multifaceted graph profile from semantically disentangled feature subspaces. The framework first uncovers latent graph-aware patterns via a multi-dimensional discriminator; these patterns then guide the dynamic construction of a stack of activation graphs; and this multifaceted profile is finally aggregated and contextualized by a relational fusion engine for a robust diagnosis. Extensive experiments on two diverse tasks, comprising over 1300 patient samples, demonstrate that MAPI-GNN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
comment: Accepted by Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 40 (AAAI-26)

AI.title_translation: 用于多模态医学诊断的多激活平面交互图神经网络：MAPI-GNN
AI.tldr: MAPI-GNN通过学习多方面图谱来解决单图局限性，在多模态医学诊断中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图神经网络在多模态医学诊断中的应用受限于单一、静态图的构建，无法有效建模患者特异性病理关系。
AI.method: MAPI-GNN通过多维判别器发现潜在的图感知模式，指导激活图的动态构建，并通过关系融合引擎聚合以进行诊断。
AI.result: MAPI-GNN在两项不同任务的1300多名患者样本的实验中，显著优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: MAPI-GNN通过学习多方面图谱，克服了单图方法的局限性，在多模态医学诊断中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 图神经网络因其固有的关系建模能力，越来越多地应用于多模态医学诊断。然而，它们的效果常常因普遍依赖于从无差别特征构建的单一、静态图而受到损害，阻碍了对患者特异性病理关系进行建模的能力。为此，提出的多激活平面交互图神经网络（MAPI-GNN）通过从语义解耦的特征子空间学习多方面图谱，重建了这种单图范式。该框架首先通过多维判别器揭示潜在的图感知模式；然后，这些模式指导激活图堆栈的动态构建；最后，通过关系融合引擎聚合并情境化这种多方面图谱，以实现稳健的诊断。在包含1300多名患者样本的两项不同任务上的广泛实验表明，MAPI-GNN的性能显著优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.summary: MAPI-GNN是一种新的图神经网络模型，用于多模态医学诊断。它通过学习患者特异性的多方面图谱，克服了传统单图方法的局限性，并在实验中展现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络,多模态医学诊断,MAPI-GNN,多方面图谱,关系建模
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的MAPI-GNN模型，通过动态构建和聚合多方面图谱来解决多模态医学诊断中的关键挑战，即单图方法的局限性。实验结果表明其优越性，为未来的研究提供了有前景的方向。

title: DecoKAN: Interpretable Decomposition for Forecasting Cryptocurrency Market Dynamics
summary: Accurate and interpretable forecasting of multivariate time series is crucial for understanding the complex dynamics of cryptocurrency markets in digital asset systems. Advanced deep learning methodologies, particularly Transformer-based and MLP-based architectures, have achieved competitive predictive performance in cryptocurrency forecasting tasks. However, cryptocurrency data is inherently composed of long-term socio-economic trends and local high-frequency speculative oscillations. Existing deep learning-based 'black-box' models fail to effectively decouple these composite dynamics or provide the interpretability needed for trustworthy financial decision-making. To overcome these limitations, we propose DecoKAN, an interpretable forecasting framework that integrates multi-level Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) for decoupling and hierarchical signal decomposition with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) mixers for transparent and interpretable nonlinear modeling. The DWT component decomposes complex cryptocurrency time series into distinct frequency components, enabling frequency-specific analysis, while KAN mixers provide intrinsically interpretable spline-based mappings within each decomposed subseries. Furthermore, interpretability is enhanced through a symbolic analysis pipeline involving sparsification, pruning, and symbolization, which produces concise analytical expressions offering symbolic representations of the learned patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoKAN achieves the lowest average Mean Squared Error on all tested real-world cryptocurrency datasets (BTC, ETH, XMR), consistently outperforming a comprehensive suite of competitive state-of-the-art baselines. These results validate DecoKAN's potential to bridge the gap between predictive accuracy and model transparency, advancing trustworthy decision support within complex cryptocurrency markets.

AI.title_translation: DecoKAN：可解释分解用于预测加密货币市场动态
AI.tldr: DecoKAN是一个新的可解释框架，它使用离散小波变换（DWT）来分解加密货币时间序列，并使用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）进行建模，以区分长期社会经济趋势和短期投机性波动。实验表明，DecoKAN在预测准确性方面优于现有方法，并提供了可解释的符号表示，有助于做出更值得信赖的金融决策。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在预测加密货币市场时表现不佳，因为它们无法有效地区分长期社会经济趋势和短期投机性波动，并且缺乏可解释性，这对于金融决策至关重要。
AI.method: DecoKAN框架结合了多级离散小波变换（DWT）和Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）混合器。DWT用于分解加密货币时间序列，KAN用于对分解后的子序列进行建模。此外，还采用了一个符号分析流程（包括稀疏化、剪枝和符号化）来增强可解释性，并生成简洁的符号表达式。
AI.result: DecoKAN在所有测试的真实世界加密货币数据集（BTC、ETH、XMR）上实现了最低的平均均方误差，并且在预测准确性方面持续优于一系列具有竞争力的最先进基线模型。
AI.conclusion: DecoKAN通过有效地区分和建模加密货币市场中的长期和短期动态，并在预测准确性和模型可解释性之间取得了平衡，为复杂加密货币市场中的可信决策支持提供了新的途径。
AI.translation: 准确且可解释的多元时间序列预测对于理解数字资产系统中加密货币市场的复杂动态至关重要。先进的深度学习方法，特别是基于Transformer和基于MLP的架构，在加密货币预测任务中取得了有竞争力的预测性能。然而，加密货币数据本质上由长期的社会经济趋势和局部的短期投机波动组成。现有的基于深度学习的“黑箱”模型未能有效地区分这些复合动态，也未能提供值得信赖的金融决策所需的解释性。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了DecoKAN，一个可解释的预测框架，它集成了多级离散小波变换（DWT）以进行分解和分层信号分解，以及Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）混合器以进行透明和可解释的非线性建模。DWT组件将复杂的加密货币时间序列分解为不同的频率分量，从而能够进行特定频率的分析，而KAN混合器在每个分解的子序列内提供内在地可解释的基于样条的映射。此外，通过涉及稀疏化、剪枝和符号化的符号分析流程来增强可解释性，该流程生成简洁的解析表达式，提供学习模式的符号表示。广泛的实验表明，DecoKAN在所有测试的真实世界加密货币数据集（BTC、ETH、XMR）上实现了最低的平均均方误差，持续优于一套全面的具有竞争力的最先进基线。这些结果证实了DecoKAN在弥合预测准确性与模型透明度之间的差距方面的潜力，从而促进了复杂加密货币市场中可信的决策支持。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了DecoKAN，一种新颖的可解释预测框架，用于分析加密货币市场的复杂动态。DecoKAN利用离散小波变换（DWT）将时间序列分解为不同的频率分量，并结合Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）进行可解释的建模，以区分长期社会经济趋势和短期投机波动。该框架还包括一个符号分析流程，以提供学习模式的符号表示。实验证明，DecoKAN在预测准确性方面优于现有基线，并有望提高金融决策的可信度。
AI.keywords: 加密货币预测, 可解释性, 离散小波变换, Kolmogorov-Arnold网络, 时间序列分析
AI.comments: DecoKAN在解决深度学习模型在加密货币预测中的可解释性问题上取得了显著进展。通过结合DWT和KAN，该方法不仅提高了预测准确性，还提供了对市场动态的洞察，这对于金融领域的实际应用至关重要。然而，该方法在处理不同频率分量时的计算效率和泛化能力仍有待进一步研究。

title: $\text{H}^2$em: Learning Hierarchical Hyperbolic Embeddings for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize unseen state-object compositions by generalizing from a training set of their primitives (state and object). Current methods often overlook the rich hierarchical structures, such as the semantic hierarchy of primitives (e.g., apple fruit) and the conceptual hierarchy between primitives and compositions (e.g, sliced apple apple). A few recent efforts have shown effectiveness in modeling these hierarchies through loss regularization within Euclidean space. In this paper, we argue that they fail to scale to the large-scale taxonomies required for real-world CZSL: the space's polynomial volume growth in flat geometry cannot match the exponential structure, impairing generalization capacity. To this end, we propose H2em, a new framework that learns Hierarchical Hyperbolic EMbeddings for CZSL. H2em leverages the unique properties of hyperbolic geometry, a space naturally suited for embedding tree-like structures with low distortion. However, a naive hyperbolic mapping may suffer from hierarchical collapse and poor fine-grained discrimination. We further design two learning objectives to structure this space: a Dual-Hierarchical Entailment Loss that uses hyperbolic entailment cones to enforce the predefined hierarchies, and a Discriminative Alignment Loss with hard negative mining to establish a large geodesic distance between semantically similar compositions. Furthermore, we devise Hyperbolic Cross-Modal Attention to realize instance-aware cross-modal infusion within hyperbolic geometry. Extensive ablations on three benchmarks demonstrate that H2em establishes a new state-of-the-art in both closed-world and open-world scenarios. Our codes will be released.

AI.title_translation: 分层双曲嵌入用于组合零样本学习的 H2em
AI.tldr: H2em 框架通过利用双曲几何的特性来学习分层双曲嵌入，以解决组合零样本学习中的层次结构问题，并在三个基准测试中取得了最先进的成果。
AI.motivation: 当前组合零样本学习方法忽略了原语的丰富层次结构（例如，苹果是一种水果）以及原语和组合之间的概念层次结构（例如，“切开的苹果”是一种“苹果”），并且在欧几里得空间中建模这些层次结构的方法无法扩展到大规模分类。H2em 旨在通过利用双曲几何来解决这个问题，因为双曲几何天然适合以低失真嵌入树状结构。
AI.method: H2em 框架通过以下方式学习分层双曲嵌入：1. 使用双曲的蕴含锥来强制执行预定义的层次结构，即双分层蕴含损失。2. 通过困难负例挖掘来确立语义相似组合之间的大测地线距离，即判别性对齐损失。3. 通过双曲跨模态注意力来实现实例感知的跨模态注入。
AI.result: H2em 在三个基准测试中均取得了最先进的性能，并在封闭世界和开放世界场景中均表现出色。
AI.conclusion: H2em 框架通过利用双曲几何的特性，并结合双分层蕴含损失、判别性对齐损失和双曲跨模态注意力，成功地解决了组合零样本学习中的层次结构问题，并在各种场景下实现了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 组合零样本学习（CZSL）旨在通过从训练集中其原语（状态和对象）进行泛化来识别看不见的状态-对象组合。当前的方法常常忽略丰富的层次结构，例如原语的语义层次（例如，苹果是一种水果）以及原语和组合之间的概念层次（例如，“切开的苹果”是一种“苹果”）。一些最新的研究表明，在欧几里得空间中通过损失正则化来建模这些层次结构是有效的。在本文中，我们认为它们无法扩展到现实世界 CZSL 所需的大规模分类：平坦几何的体积多项式增长无法匹配指数结构，从而削弱了泛化能力。为此，我们提出了 H2em，这是一个学习用于 CZSL 的分层双曲嵌入的新框架。H2em 利用双曲几何的独特性质，这种空间天然适合以低失真嵌入树状结构。然而，朴素的双曲映射可能会遭受层次结构坍塌和区分度差的问题。我们进一步设计了两个学习目标来构建这个空间：一个双分层蕴含损失，它使用双曲蕴含锥来强制执行预定义的层次结构；以及一个具有困难负例挖掘的判别性对齐损失，用于在语义相似的组合之间建立大的测地线距离。此外，我们设计了双曲跨模态注意力，以在双曲几何中实现实例感知的跨模态注入。在三个基准测试上的广泛消融研究表明，H2em 在封闭世界和开放世界场景中均建立了新的最先进水平。我们的代码将发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 H2em 框架，用于解决组合零样本学习（CZSL）中的层次结构问题。与仅在欧几里得空间中建模层次结构并存在扩展性问题的现有方法不同，H2em 利用双曲几何的特性，该几何天然适合表示树状结构。为了克服朴素双曲映射的缺点，H2em 引入了双分层蕴含损失来强制执行层次结构，判别性对齐损失来区分相似的组合，以及双曲跨模态注意力来实现跨模态信息融合。实验结果表明，H2em 在三个基准测试中均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 组合零样本学习, 分层双曲嵌入, 双曲几何, 层次结构, 跨模态注意力
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的 H2em 框架，用于组合零样本学习 (CZSL)，通过利用双曲几何来解决现有方法在处理大规模层次结构时的局限性。该方法通过引入双分层蕴含损失和判别性对齐损失来有效建模层次结构，并通过双曲跨模态注意力实现跨模态信息融合。研究结果表明，H2em 在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的成果，这表明双曲几何在 CZSL 领域具有巨大的潜力。然而，该方法在处理极端大规模的分类或非常深的层次结构时的扩展性和鲁棒性仍有待进一步研究。

title: VALLR-Pin: Dual-Decoding Visual Speech Recognition for Mandarin with Pinyin-Guided LLM Refinement
summary: Visual Speech Recognition aims to transcribe spoken words from silent lip-motion videos. This task is particularly challenging for Mandarin, as visemes are highly ambiguous and homophones are prevalent. We propose VALLR-Pin, a novel two-stage framework that extends the recent VALLR architecture from English to Mandarin. First, a shared video encoder feeds into dual decoders, which jointly predict both Chinese character sequences and their standard Pinyin romanization. The multi-task learning of character and phonetic outputs fosters robust visual-semantic representations. During inference, the text decoder generates multiple candidate transcripts. We construct a prompt by concatenating the Pinyin output with these candidate Chinese sequences and feed it to a large language model to resolve ambiguities and refine the transcription. This provides the LLM with explicit phonetic context to correct homophone-induced errors. Finally, we fine-tune the LLM on synthetic noisy examples: we generate imperfect Pinyin-text pairs from intermediate VALLR-Pin checkpoints using the training data, creating instruction-response pairs for error correction. This endows the LLM with awareness of our model's specific error patterns. In summary, VALLR-Pin synergizes visual features with phonetic and linguistic context to improve Mandarin lip-reading performance.

title: FlashLips: 100-FPS Mask-Free Latent Lip-Sync using Reconstruction Instead of Diffusion or GANs
summary: We present FlashLips, a two-stage, mask-free lip-sync system that decouples lips control from rendering and achieves real-time performance running at over 100 FPS on a single GPU, while matching the visual quality of larger state-of-the-art models. Stage 1 is a compact, one-step latent-space editor that reconstructs an image using a reference identity, a masked target frame, and a low-dimensional lips-pose vector, trained purely with reconstruction losses - no GANs or diffusion. To remove explicit masks at inference, we use self-supervision: we generate mouth-altered variants of the target image, that serve as pseudo ground truth for fine-tuning, teaching the network to localize edits to the lips while preserving the rest. Stage 2 is an audio-to-pose transformer trained with a flow-matching objective to predict lips-poses vectors from speech. Together, these stages form a simple and stable pipeline that combines deterministic reconstruction with robust audio control, delivering high perceptual quality and faster-than-real-time speed.

title: VSA:Visual-Structural Alignment for UI-to-Code
summary: The automation of user interface development has the potential to accelerate software delivery by mitigating intensive manual implementation. Despite the advancements in Large Multimodal Models for design-to-code translation, existing methodologies predominantly yield unstructured, flat codebases that lack compatibility with component-oriented libraries such as React or Angular. Such outputs typically exhibit low cohesion and high coupling, complicating long-term maintenance. In this paper, we propose \textbf{VSA (VSA)}, a multi-stage paradigm designed to synthesize organized frontend assets through visual-structural alignment. Our approach first employs a spatial-aware transformer to reconstruct the visual input into a hierarchical tree representation. Moving beyond basic layout extraction, we integrate an algorithmic pattern-matching layer to identify recurring UI motifs and encapsulate them into modular templates. These templates are then processed via a schema-driven synthesis engine, ensuring the Large Language Model generates type-safe, prop-drilled components suitable for production environments. Experimental results indicate that our framework yields a substantial improvement in code modularity and architectural consistency over state-of-the-art benchmarks, effectively bridging the gap between raw pixels and scalable software engineering.

title: Beyond Vision: Contextually Enriched Image Captioning with Multi-Modal Retrieva
comments: 7 pages, 5 figures. System description for the EVENTA Grand Challenge (Track 1) at ACM MM'25
summary: Real-world image captions often lack contextual depth, omitting crucial details such as event background, temporal cues, outcomes, and named entities that are not visually discernible. This gap limits the effectiveness of image understanding in domains like journalism, education, and digital archives, where richer, more informative descriptions are essential. To address this, we propose a multimodal pipeline that augments visual input with external textual knowledge. Our system retrieves semantically similar images using BEIT-3 (Flickr30k-384 and COCO-384) and SigLIP So-384, reranks them using ORB and SIFT for geometric alignment, and extracts contextual information from related articles via semantic search. A fine-tuned Qwen3 model with QLoRA then integrates this context with base captions generated by Instruct BLIP (Vicuna-7B) to produce event-enriched, context-aware descriptions. Evaluated on the OpenEvents v1 dataset, our approach generates significantly more informative captions compared to traditional methods, showing strong potential for real-world applications requiring deeper visual-textual understanding
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. System description for the EVENTA Grand Challenge (Track 1) at ACM MM'25

title: Discovering Lie Groups with Flow Matching
summary: Symmetry is fundamental to understanding physical systems, and at the same time, can improve performance and sample efficiency in machine learning. Both pursuits require knowledge of the underlying symmetries in data. To address this, we propose learning symmetries directly from data via flow matching on Lie groups. We formulate symmetry discovery as learning a distribution over a larger hypothesis group, such that the learned distribution matches the symmetries observed in data. Relative to previous works, our method, \lieflow, is more flexible in terms of the types of groups it can discover and requires fewer assumptions. Experiments on 2D and 3D point clouds demonstrate the successful discovery of discrete groups, including reflections by flow matching over the complex domain. We identify a key challenge where the symmetric arrangement of the target modes causes ``last-minute convergence,'' where samples remain stationary until relatively late in the flow, and introduce a novel interpolation scheme for flow matching for symmetry discovery.

title: Learning Skills from Action-Free Videos
summary: Learning from videos offers a promising path toward generalist robots by providing rich visual and temporal priors beyond what real robot datasets contain. While existing video generative models produce impressive visual predictions, they are difficult to translate into low-level actions. Conversely, latent-action models better align videos with actions, but they typically operate at the single-step level and lack high-level planning capabilities. We bridge this gap by introducing Skill Abstraction from Optical Flow (SOF), a framework that learns latent skills from large collections of action-free videos. Our key idea is to learn a latent skill space through an intermediate representation based on optical flow that captures motion information aligned with both video dynamics and robot actions. By learning skills in this flow-based latent space, SOF enables high-level planning over video-derived skills and allows for easier translation of these skills into actions. Experiments show that our approach consistently improves performance in both multitask and long-horizon settings, demonstrating the ability to acquire and compose skills directly from raw visual data.

title: An Optimal Policy for Learning Controllable Dynamics by Exploration
summary: Controllable Markov chains describe the dynamics of sequential decision making tasks and are the central component in optimal control and reinforcement learning. In this work, we give the general form of an optimal policy for learning controllable dynamics in an unknown environment by exploring over a limited time horizon. This policy is simple to implement and efficient to compute, and allows an agent to ``learn by exploring" as it maximizes its information gain in a greedy fashion by selecting controls from a constraint set that changes over time during exploration. We give a simple parameterization for the set of controls, and present an algorithm for finding an optimal policy. The reason for this policy is due to the existence of certain types of states that restrict control of the dynamics; such as transient states, absorbing states, and non-backtracking states. We show why the occurrence of these states makes a non-stationary policy essential for achieving optimal exploration. Six interesting examples of controllable dynamics are treated in detail. Policy optimality is demonstrated using counting arguments, comparing with suboptimal policies, and by making use of a sequential improvement property from dynamic programming.

title: Towards Generative Location Awareness for Disaster Response: A Probabilistic Cross-view Geolocalization Approach
summary: As Earth's climate changes, it is impacting disasters and extreme weather events across the planet. Record-breaking heat waves, drenching rainfalls, extreme wildfires, and widespread flooding during hurricanes are all becoming more frequent and more intense. Rapid and efficient response to disaster events is essential for climate resilience and sustainability. A key challenge in disaster response is to accurately and quickly identify disaster locations to support decision-making and resources allocation. In this paper, we propose a Probabilistic Cross-view Geolocalization approach, called ProbGLC, exploring new pathways towards generative location awareness for rapid disaster response. Herein, we combine probabilistic and deterministic geolocalization models into a unified framework to simultaneously enhance model explainability (via uncertainty quantification) and achieve state-of-the-art geolocalization performance. Designed for rapid diaster response, the ProbGLC is able to address cross-view geolocalization across multiple disaster events as well as to offer unique features of probabilistic distribution and localizability score. To evaluate the ProbGLC, we conduct extensive experiments on two cross-view disaster datasets (i.e., MultiIAN and SAGAINDisaster), consisting diverse cross-view imagery pairs of multiple disaster types (e.g., hurricanes, wildfires, floods, to tornadoes). Preliminary results confirms the superior geolocalization accuracy (i.e., 0.86 in Acc@1km and 0.97 in Acc@25km) and model explainability (i.e., via probabilistic distributions and localizability scores) of the proposed ProbGLC approach, highlighting the great potential of leveraging generative cross-view approach to facilitate location awareness for better and faster disaster response. The data and code is publicly available at https://github.com/bobleegogogo/ProbGLC

title: Deep Eigenspace Network and Its Application to Parametric Non-selfadjoint Eigenvalue Problems
summary: We consider operator learning for efficiently solving parametric non-selfadjoint eigenvalue problems. To overcome the spectral instability and mode switching inherent in non-selfadjoint operators, we introduce a hybrid framework that learns the stable invariant eigensubspace mapping rather than individual eigenfunctions. We proposed a Deep Eigenspace Network (DEN) architecture integrating Fourier Neural Operators, geometry-adaptive POD bases, and explicit banded cross-mode mixing mechanisms to capture complex spectral dependencies on unstructured meshes. We apply DEN to the parametric non-selfadjoint Steklov eigenvalue problem and provide theoretical proofs for the Lipschitz continuity of the eigensubspace with respect to the parameters. In addition, we derive error bounds for the reconstruction of the eigenspace. Numerical experiments validate DEN's high accuracy and zero-shot generalization capabilities across different discretizations.

title: DS-HGCN: A Dual-Stream Hypergraph Convolutional Network for Predicting Student Engagement via Social Contagion
summary: Student engagement is a critical factor influencing academic success and learning outcomes. Accurately predicting student engagement is essential for optimizing teaching strategies and providing personalized interventions. However, most approaches focus on single-dimensional feature analysis and assessing engagement based on individual student factors. In this work, we propose a dual-stream multi-feature fusion model based on hypergraph convolutional networks (DS-HGCN), incorporating social contagion of student engagement. DS-HGCN enables accurate prediction of student engagement states by modeling multi-dimensional features and their propagation mechanisms between students. The framework constructs a hypergraph structure to encode engagement contagion among students and captures the emotional and behavioral differences and commonalities by multi-frequency signals. Furthermore, we introduce a hypergraph attention mechanism to dynamically weigh the influence of each student, accounting for individual differences in the propagation process. Extensive experiments on public benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance and significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches.

title: Scaling Reinforcement Learning for Content Moderation with Large Language Models
summary: Content moderation at scale remains one of the most pressing challenges in today's digital ecosystem, where billions of user- and AI-generated artifacts must be continuously evaluated for policy violations. Although recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for policy-grounded moderation, the practical challenges of training these systems to achieve expert-level accuracy in real-world settings remain largely unexplored, particularly in regimes characterized by label sparsity, evolving policy definitions, and the need for nuanced reasoning beyond shallow pattern matching. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical investigation of scaling reinforcement learning (RL) for content classification, systematically evaluating multiple RL training recipes and reward-shaping strategies-including verifiable rewards and LLM-as-judge frameworks-to transform general-purpose language models into specialized, policy-aligned classifiers across three real-world content moderation tasks. Our findings provide actionable insights for industrial-scale moderation systems, demonstrating that RL exhibits sigmoid-like scaling behavior in which performance improves smoothly with increased training data, rollouts, and optimization steps before gradually saturating. Moreover, we show that RL substantially improves performance on tasks requiring complex policy-grounded reasoning while achieving up to 100x higher data efficiency than supervised fine-tuning, making it particularly effective in domains where expert annotations are scarce or costly.

title: On the Effectiveness of Instruction-Tuning Local LLMs for Identifying Software Vulnerabilities
comments: The 9th International Conference on Mobile Internet Security (MobiSec 2025)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show significant promise in automating software vulnerability analysis, a critical task given the impact of security failure of modern software systems. However, current approaches in using LLMs to automate vulnerability analysis mostly rely on using online API-based LLM services, requiring the user to disclose the source code in development. Moreover, they predominantly frame the task as a binary classification(vulnerable or not vulnerable), limiting potential practical utility. This paper addresses these limitations by reformulating the problem as Software Vulnerability Identification (SVI), where LLMs are asked to output the type of weakness in Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) IDs rather than simply indicating the presence or absence of a vulnerability. We also tackle the reliance on large, API-based LLMs by demonstrating that instruction-tuning smaller, locally deployable LLMs can achieve superior identification performance. In our analysis, instruct-tuning a local LLM showed better overall performance and cost trade-off than online API-based LLMs. Our findings indicate that instruct-tuned local models represent a more effective, secure, and practical approach for leveraging LLMs in real-world vulnerability management workflows.
comment: The 9th International Conference on Mobile Internet Security (MobiSec 2025)

title: PairFlow: Closed-Form Source-Target Coupling for Few-Step Generation in Discrete Flow Models
summary: We introduce $\texttt{PairFlow}$, a lightweight preprocessing step for training Discrete Flow Models (DFMs) to achieve few-step sampling without requiring a pretrained teacher. DFMs have recently emerged as a new class of generative models for discrete data, offering strong performance. However, they suffer from slow sampling due to their iterative nature. Existing acceleration methods largely depend on finetuning, which introduces substantial additional training overhead. $\texttt{PairFlow}$ addresses this issue with a lightweight preprocessing step. Inspired by ReFlow and its extension to DFMs, we train DFMs from coupled samples of source and target distributions, without requiring any pretrained teacher. At the core of our approach is a closed-form inversion for DFMs, which allows efficient construction of paired source-target samples. Despite its extremely low cost, taking only up to 1.7% of the compute needed for full model training, $\texttt{PairFlow}$ matches or even surpasses the performance of two-stage training involving finetuning. Furthermore, models trained with our framework provide stronger base models for subsequent distillation, yielding further acceleration after finetuning. Experiments on molecular data as well as binary and RGB images demonstrate the broad applicability and effectiveness of our approach.

title: FastMPS: Revisit Data Parallel in Large-scale Matrix Product State Sampling
summary: Matrix Product State (MPS) is a versatile tensor network representation widely applied in quantum physics, quantum chemistry, and machine learning, etc. MPS sampling serves as a critical fundamental operation in these fields. As the problems become more complex, the scale of MPS is rapidly increasing. Traditional data parallelism is limited by memory and heavy I/O in large-scale MPS. Model parallelism that can handle large-scale MPS imposes rigid process bindings and lacks scalability. This work proposes Fast-MPS, a multi-level parallel framework for scalable MPS sampling. Our design combines data parallelism across samples with tensor parallelism along bond dimensions. We eliminate memory and I/O pressure through compression and overlapping, and revive data parallel in large-scale MPS sampling. We evaluate our approach on Gaussian Boson Sampling, a representative and demanding application. Fast-MPS achieves over 10x speedup compared to existing simulators, scales to thousands of processes, and enables simulations with 8,176 sites and bond dimension chi = 10^4, significantly outperforming the state of the art. Fast-MPS has demonstrated great potential in high-performance tensor network applications.

title: Progressive Learned Image Compression for Machine Perception
summary: Recent advances in learned image codecs have been extended from human perception toward machine perception. However, progressive image compression with fine granular scalability (FGS)-which enables decoding a single bitstream at multiple quality levels-remains unexplored for machine-oriented codecs. In this work, we propose a novel progressive learned image compression codec for machine perception, PICM-Net, based on trit-plane coding. By analyzing the difference between human- and machine-oriented rate-distortion priorities, we systematically examine the latent prioritization strategies in terms of machine-oriented codecs. To further enhance real-world adaptability, we design an adaptive decoding controller, which dynamically determines the necessary decoding level during inference time to maintain the desired confidence of downstream machine prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach enables efficient and adaptive progressive transmission while maintaining high performance in the downstream classification task, establishing a new paradigm for machine-aware progressive image compression.

title: 3D Stack In-Sensor-Computing (3DS-ISC): Accelerating Time-Surface Construction for Neuromorphic Event Cameras
summary: This work proposes a 3D Stack In-Sensor-Computing (3DS-ISC) architecture for efficient event-based vision processing. A real-time normalization method using an exponential decay function is introduced to construct the time-surface, reducing hardware usage while preserving temporal information. The circuit design utilizes the leakage characterization of Dynamic Random Access Memory(DRAM) for timestamp normalization. Custom interdigitated metal-oxide-metal capacitor (MOMCAP) is used to store the charge and low leakage switch (LL switch) is used to extend the effective charge storage time. The 3DS-ISC architecture integrates sensing, memory, and computation to overcome the memory wall problem, reducing power, latency, and reducing area by 69x, 2.2x and 1.9x, respectively, compared with its 2D counterpart. Moreover, compared to works using a 16-bit SRAM to store timestamps, the ISC analog array can reduce power consumption by three orders of magnitude. In real computer vision (CV) tasks, we applied the spatial-temporal correlation filter (STCF) for denoise, and 3D-ISC achieved almost equivalent accuracy compared to the digital implementation using high precision timestamps. As for the image classification, time-surface constructed by 3D-ISC is used as the input of GoogleNet, achieving 99% on N-MNIST, 85% on N-Caltech101, 78% on CIFAR10-DVS, and 97% on DVS128 Gesture, comparable with state-of-the-art results on each dataset. Additionally, the 3D-ISC method is also applied to image reconstruction using the DAVIS240C dataset, achieving the highest average SSIM (0.62) among three methods. This work establishes a foundation for real-time, resource-efficient event-based processing and points to future integration of advanced computational circuits for broader applications.

title: Reason2Decide: Rationale-Driven Multi-Task Learning
summary: Despite the wide adoption of Large Language Models (LLM)s, clinical decision support systems face a critical challenge: achieving high predictive accuracy while generating explanations aligned with the predictions. Current approaches suffer from exposure bias leading to misaligned explanations. We propose Reason2Decide, a two-stage training framework that addresses key challenges in self-rationalization, including exposure bias and task separation. In Stage-1, our model is trained on rationale generation, while in Stage-2, we jointly train on label prediction and rationale generation, applying scheduled sampling to gradually transition from conditioning on gold labels to model predictions. We evaluate Reason2Decide on three medical datasets, including a proprietary triage dataset and public biomedical QA datasets. Across model sizes, Reason2Decide outperforms other fine-tuning baselines and some zero-shot LLMs in prediction (F1) and rationale fidelity (BERTScore, BLEU, LLM-as-a-Judge). In triage, Reason2Decide is rationale source-robust across LLM-generated, nurse-authored, and nurse-post-processed rationales. In our experiments, while using only LLM-generated rationales in Stage-1, Reason2Decide outperforms other fine-tuning variants. This indicates that LLM-generated rationales are suitable for pretraining models, reducing reliance on human annotations. Remarkably, Reason2Decide achieves these gains with models 40x smaller than contemporary foundation models, making clinical reasoning more accessible for resource-constrained deployments while still providing explainable decision support.

title: From Dissipativity Property to Data-Driven GAS Certificate of Degree-One Homogeneous Networks with Unknown Topology
summary: In this work, we propose a data-driven divide and conquer strategy for the stability analysis of interconnected homogeneous nonlinear networks of degree one with unknown models and a fully unknown topology. The proposed scheme leverages joint dissipativity-type properties of subsystems described by storage functions, while providing a stability certificate over unknown interconnected networks. In our data-driven framework, we begin by formulating the required conditions for constructing storage functions as a robust convex program (RCP). Given that unknown models of subsystems are integrated into one of the constraints of the RCP, we collect data from trajectories of each unknown subsystem and provide a scenario convex program (SCP) that aligns with the original RCP. We solve the SCP as a linear program and construct a storage function for each subsystem with unknown dynamics. Under some newly developed data-driven compositionality conditions, we then construct a Lyapunov function for the fully unknown interconnected network utilizing storage functions derived from data of individual subsystems. We show that our data-driven {divide and conquer strategy} provides correctness guarantees (as opposed to probabilistic confidence) while significantly mitigating the sample complexity problem existing in data-driven approaches. To illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed results, we apply our approaches to three different case studies involving interconnected homogeneous (nonlinear) networks with unknown models. We collect data from trajectories of unknown subsystems and verify the global asymptotic stability (GAS) of the interconnected system with a guaranteed confidence.

title: CBA: Communication-Bound-Aware Cross-Domain Resource Assignment for Pipeline-Parallel Distributed LLM Training in Dynamic Multi-DC Optical Networks
summary: We propose a communication-bound-aware cross-domain resource assignment framework for pipeline-parallel distributed training over multi-datacenter optical networks, which lowers iteration time by 31.25% and reduces 13.20% blocking requests compared to baselines.

title: Adaptive Financial Sentiment Analysis for NIFTY 50 via Instruction-Tuned LLMs , RAG and Reinforcement Learning Approaches
summary: Financial sentiment analysis plays a crucial role in informing investment decisions, assessing market risk, and predicting stock price trends. Existing works in financial sentiment analysis have not considered the impact of stock prices or market feedback on sentiment analysis. In this paper, we propose an adaptive framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) with real-world stock market feedback to improve sentiment classification in the context of the Indian stock market. The proposed methodology fine-tunes the LLaMA 3.2 3B model using instruction-based learning on the SentiFin dataset. To enhance sentiment predictions, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline is employed that dynamically selects multi-source contextual information based on the cosine similarity of the sentence embeddings. Furthermore, a feedback-driven module is introduced that adjusts the reliability of the source by comparing predicted sentiment with actual next-day stock returns, allowing the system to iteratively adapt to market behavior. To generalize this adaptive mechanism across temporal data, a reinforcement learning agent trained using proximal policy optimization (PPO) is incorporated. The PPO agent learns to optimize source weighting policies based on cumulative reward signals from sentiment-return alignment. Experimental results on NIFTY 50 news headlines collected from 2024 to 2025 demonstrate that the proposed system significantly improves classification accuracy, F1-score, and market alignment over baseline models and static retrieval methods. The results validate the potential of combining instruction-tuned LLMs with dynamic feedback and reinforcement learning for robust, market-aware financial sentiment modeling.

title: Detecting Non-Optimal Decisions of Embodied Agents via Diversity-Guided Metamorphic Testing
summary: As embodied agents advance toward real-world deployment, ensuring optimal decisions becomes critical for resource-constrained applications. Current evaluation methods focus primarily on functional correctness, overlooking the non-functional optimality of generated plans. This gap can lead to significant performance degradation and resource waste. We identify and formalize the problem of Non-optimal Decisions (NoDs), where agents complete tasks successfully but inefficiently. We present NoD-DGMT, a systematic framework for detecting NoDs in embodied agent task planning via diversity-guided metamorphic testing. Our key insight is that optimal planners should exhibit invariant behavioral properties under specific transformations. We design four novel metamorphic relations capturing fundamental optimality properties: position detour suboptimality, action optimality completeness, condition refinement monotonicity, and scene perturbation invariance. To maximize detection efficiency, we introduce a diversity-guided selection strategy that actively selects test cases exploring different violation categories, avoiding redundant evaluations while ensuring comprehensive diversity coverage. Extensive experiments on the AI2-THOR simulator with four state-of-the-art planning models demonstrate that NoD-DGMT achieves violation detection rates of 31.9% on average, with our diversity-guided filter improving rates by 4.3% and diversity scores by 3.3 on average. NoD-DGMT significantly outperforms six baseline methods, with 16.8% relative improvement over the best baseline, and demonstrates consistent superiority across different model architectures and task complexities.

title: QE-Catalytic: A Graph-Language Multimodal Base Model for Relaxed-Energy Prediction in Catalytic Adsorption
summary:
Adsorption energy is a key descriptor of catalytic reactivity. It is fundamentally defined as the difference between the relaxed total energy of the adsorbate-surface system and that of an appropriate reference state; therefore, the accuracy of relaxed-energy prediction directly determines the reliability of machine-learning-driven catalyst screening. E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks (GNNs) can natively operate on three-dimensional atomic coordinates under periodic boundary conditions and have demonstrated strong performance on such tasks. In contrast, language-model-based approaches, while enabling human-readable textual descriptions and reducing reliance on explicit graph -- thereby broadening applicability -- remain insufficient in both adsorption-configuration energy prediction accuracy and in distinguishing ``the same system with different configurations,'' even with graph-assisted pretraining in the style of GAP-CATBERTa.
  To this end, we propose QE-Catalytic, a multimodal framework that deeply couples a large language model (\textbf{Q}wen) with an E(3)-equivariant graph Transformer (\textbf{E}quiformer-V2), enabling unified support for adsorption-configuration property prediction and inverse design on complex catalytic surfaces. During prediction, QE-Catalytic jointly leverages three-dimensional structures and structured configuration text, and injects ``3D geometric information'' into the language channel via graph-text alignment, allowing it to function as a high-performance text-based predictor when precise coordinates are unavailable, while also autoregressively generating CIF files for target-energy-driven structure design and information completion. On OC20, QE-Catalytic reduces the MAE of relaxed adsorption energy from 0.713~eV to 0.486~eV, and consistently outperforms baseline models such as CatBERTa and GAP-CATBERTa across multiple evaluation protocols.

title: Spatio-Temporal Graphs Beyond Grids: Benchmark for Maritime Anomaly Detection
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 Workshop in AI for Science: The Reach and Limits of AI for Scientific Discovery
summary: Spatio-temporal graph neural networks (ST-GNNs) have achieved notable success in structured domains such as road traffic and public transportation, where spatial entities can be naturally represented as fixed nodes. In contrast, many real-world systems including maritime traffic lack such fixed anchors, making the construction of spatio-temporal graphs a fundamental challenge. Anomaly detection in these non-grid environments is particularly difficult due to the absence of canonical reference points, the sparsity and irregularity of trajectories, and the fact that anomalies may manifest at multiple granularities. In this work, we introduce a novel benchmark dataset for anomaly detection in the maritime domain, extending the Open Maritime Traffic Analysis Dataset (OMTAD) into a benchmark tailored for graph-based anomaly detection. Our dataset enables systematic evaluation across three different granularities: node-level, edge-level, and graph-level anomalies. We plan to employ two specialized LLM-based agents: \emph{Trajectory Synthesizer} and \emph{Anomaly Injector} to construct richer interaction contexts and generate semantically meaningful anomalies. We expect this benchmark to promote reproducibility and to foster methodological advances in anomaly detection for non-grid spatio-temporal systems.

title: Item Region-based Style Classification Network (IRSN): A Fashion Style Classifier Based on Domain Knowledge of Fashion Experts
comments: This is a pre-print of an article published in Applied Intelligence. The final authenticated version is available online at: https://doi.org/10.1007/s10489-024-05683-9
summary:
Fashion style classification is a challenging task because of the large visual variation within the same style and the existence of visually similar styles.
  Styles are expressed not only by the global appearance, but also by the attributes of individual items and their combinations.
  In this study, we propose an item region-based fashion style classification network (IRSN) to effectively classify fashion styles by analyzing item-specific features and their combinations in addition to global features.
  IRSN extracts features of each item region using item region pooling (IRP), analyzes them separately, and combines them using gated feature fusion (GFF).
  In addition, we improve the feature extractor by applying a dual-backbone architecture that combines a domain-specific feature extractor and a general feature extractor pre-trained with a large-scale image-text dataset.
  In experiments, applying IRSN to six widely-used backbones, including EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, and Swin Transformer, improved style classification accuracy by an average of 6.9% and a maximum of 14.5% on the FashionStyle14 dataset and by an average of 7.6% and a maximum of 15.1% on the ShowniqV3 dataset. Visualization analysis also supports that the IRSN models are better than the baseline models at capturing differences between similar style classes.
