This finding suggests that the oversimplification of existing benchmarks might lead to an overestimation of the performance of RCA methods. To further investigate the oversimplification issue, we conduct a systematic analysis of popular public RCA benchmarks, identifying key limitations in their fault injection strategies, call graph structures, and telemetry signal patterns. Based on these insights, we propose an automated framework for generating more challenging and comprehensive benchmarks that include complex fault propagation scenarios. Our new dataset contains 1,430 validated failure cases from 9,152 fault injections, covering 25 fault types across 6 categories, dynamic workloads, and hierarchical ground-truth labels that map failures from services down to code-level causes. Crucially, to ensure the failure cases are relevant to IT operations, each case is validated to have a discernible impact on user-facing SLIs. Our re-evaluation of 11 SOTA models on this new benchmark shows that they achieve low Top@1 accuracies, averaging 0.21, with the best-performing model reaching merely 0.37, and execution times escalating from seconds to hours.
comment: directly accepted by FSE'26, 87/920. project page: https://operationspai.github.io/revisiting-rca-evaluation/; dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17105974

AI.title_translation: 重新思考具有故障传播感知基准的微服务根本原因分析评估
AI.tldr: 现有微服务根本原因分析（RCA）基准过于简单，导致对RCA方法性能的估计过高。本研究提出了一个更具挑战性的新基准，其中SOTA模型在该基准上的表现不佳，平均准确率为0.21。
AI.motivation: 现有的微服务RCA基准过于简单，无法反映真实世界的复杂性，导致对RCA方法性能的估计过高。
AI.method: 对现有RCA基准进行系统性分析，识别其在故障注入策略、调用图结构和遥测信号模式方面的局限性。基于这些见解，开发了一个自动框架来生成更具挑战性和全面的基准，包括复杂的故障传播场景。
AI.result: 新的基准包含1430个经过验证的故障案例，覆盖25种故障类型，动态工作负载和分层真实标签。在新的基准上重新评估11个SOTA模型，平均Top@1准确率仅为0.21，最佳模型准确率为0.37，执行时间从秒级延长到小时级。
AI.conclusion: 现有的微服务RCA基准存在严重缺陷，无法有效评估真实世界场景下的RCA方法。提出的新基准更能反映实际操作的复杂性，并揭示了当前SOTA模型的局限性。
AI.translation: 虽然云原生微服务架构彻底改变了软件开发，但其固有的操作复杂性使得故障根本原因分析（RCA）成为一项关键但艰巨的任务。已经提出了许多数据驱动的RCA模型来应对这一挑战。然而，我们发现用于评估这些模型的基准通常过于简单，无法反映真实世界场景。我们的初步研究表明，简单的基于规则的方法在四个广泛使用的公共基准上的性能可以与最先进（SOTA）模型相媲美甚至超越。这一发现表明，现有基准的过度简化可能导致对RCA方法性能的过高估计。为了进一步研究过度简化问题，我们对流行的公共RCA基准进行了系统分析，识别了它们在故障注入策略、调用图结构和遥测信号模式方面的关键局限性。基于这些见解，我们提出了一种自动框架，用于生成更具挑战性和更全面的基准，包括复杂的故障传播场景。我们的新数据集包含来自9,152次故障注入的1,430个经过验证的故障案例，涵盖了6个类别中的25种故障类型、动态工作负载以及将故障从服务映射到代码级原因的分层真实标签。至关重要的是，为了确保故障案例与IT运维相关，每个案例都经过验证，对面向用户的SLI有可识别的影响。我们在此新基准上对11个SOTA模型进行的重新评估表明，它们的Top@1准确率较低，平均为0.21，表现最佳的模型也仅达到0.37，并且执行时间从几秒钟增加到几个小时。
AI.summary: 本研究认为，当前用于评估微服务根本原因分析（RCA）方法的基准过于简单，无法反映真实世界的复杂性，导致对RCA模型性能的估计过高。研究人员对现有基准进行了分析，并提出了一个新的、更具挑战性的自动化基准生成框架，该框架考虑了故障传播、动态工作负载和分层真实标签。在新基准上对11个最先进（SOTA）RCA模型的重新评估表明，它们的性能显著下降，平均准确率仅为0.21，突显了现有方法在应对真实复杂故障场景时的不足。
AI.keywords: 微服务, 根本原因分析, 基准, 故障传播, 云原生
AI.comments: 这项研究非常重要，因为它揭示了当前微服务RCA评估中一个普遍存在但被忽视的问题——基准的局限性。通过提出一个更具挑战性的新基准，研究为未来RCA方法的发展提供了一个更现实的评估平台。然而，新基准的生成和验证过程可能仍然存在挑战，并且如何将这些发现推广到更广泛的系统类型也是一个值得关注的问题。

title: On Structured State-Space Duality
comments: v2 fixed typos and added numerical results (Appendix B)
summary: Structured State-Space Duality (SSD) [Dao & Gu, ICML 2024] is an equivalence between a simple Structured State-Space Model (SSM) and a masked attention mechanism. In particular, a state-space model with a scalar-times-identity state matrix is equivalent to a masked self-attention with a $1$-semiseparable causal mask. Consequently, the same sequence transformation (model) has two algorithmic realizations: as a linear-time $O(T)$ recurrence or as a quadratic-time $O(T^2)$ attention. In this note, we formalize and generalize this duality: (i) we extend SSD from the scalar-identity case to general diagonal SSMs (diagonal state matrices); (ii) we show that these diagonal SSMs match the scalar case's training complexity lower bounds while supporting richer dynamics; (iii) we establish a necessary and sufficient condition under which an SSM is equivalent to $1$-semiseparable masked attention; and (iv) we show that such duality fails to extend to standard softmax attention due to rank explosion. Together, these results tighten bridge between recurrent SSMs and Transformers, and widen the design space for expressive yet efficient sequence models.

AI.title_translation: 关于结构化状态空间对偶性
AI.tldr: 论文将结构化状态空间对偶性（SSD）推广到更通用的对角SSM，发现它们在计算效率上保持优势并具有更强的表达能力，但这种对偶性在标准Transformer的softmax注意力中失效。
AI.motivation: 在结构化状态空间模型（SSM）和掩码注意力机制之间建立和推广已知的等价性（SSD），以探索更丰富的动态模型并理解其计算复杂度的关系。
AI.method: 通过形式化和推广现有SSD（从标量恒等扩展到一般对角SSM），建立等价性条件，并分析了对偶性在标准softmax注意力下的失败情况。
AI.result: 将SSD扩展到一般对角SSM；证明对角SSM在训练复杂度上达到标量情况的下界，同时支持更丰富的动态性；建立了SSM等价于1-半可分掩码注意力的充要条件；并证明了这种对偶性不适用于标准softmax注意力。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果收紧了循环SSM与Transformer之间的联系，并拓宽了富有表现力且高效的序列模型的设计空间。
AI.translation: 结构化状态空间对偶性（SSD）[Dao & Gu, ICML 2024] 是一个简单的结构化状态空间模型（SSM）与掩码注意力机制之间的等价性。特别是，具有标量乘以恒等状态矩阵的状态空间模型等价于具有1-半可分因果掩码的掩码自注意力。因此，相同的序列变换（模型）有两种算法实现：作为线性时间 $O(T)$ 的递归或作为二次时间 $O(T^2)$ 的注意力。在本文中，我们形式化并推广了这种对偶性：（i）我们将SSD从标量恒等情况扩展到一般对角SSM（对角状态矩阵）；（ii）我们表明这些对角SSM在训练复杂度上达到了标量情况的下界，同时支持更丰富的动态性；（iii）我们确立了一个SSM等价于1-半可分掩码注意力的充要条件；（iv）我们证明了由于秩爆炸，这种对偶性未能扩展到标准softmax注意力。综合来看，这些结果收紧了循环SSM与Transformer之间的联系，并拓宽了富有表现力且高效的序列模型的设计空间。
AI.summary: 本文将结构化状态空间对偶性（SSD）从标量恒等情况推广到一般对角状态空间模型（SSM），证明了对角SSM在保持线性时间复杂度的同时支持更丰富的动态性。研究还确定了SSM等价于1-半可分掩码注意力的充要条件，并指出这种对偶性不适用于标准softmax注意力，从而深化了SSM与Transformer的联系。
AI.keywords: 结构化状态空间对偶性, 对角SSM, 掩码注意力, 1-半可分, 序列模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将结构化状态空间对偶性（SSD）从标量恒等情况推广到更一般的对角SSM，并建立了SSM等价于1-半可分掩码注意力的充分必要条件。其重要性在于加深了SSM与Transformer之间的联系，并为设计高效、表达力强的序列模型拓宽了空间。局限性在于指出这种对偶性不适用于标准softmax注意力。

title: Automated Program Repair of Uncompilable Student Code
comments: In Proceedings of the 57th ACM Technical Symposium on Computer Science Education V.2 (SIGCSE TS 2026)
summary: A significant portion of student programming submissions in CS1 learning environments are uncompilable, limiting their use in student modeling and downstream knowledge tracing. Traditional modeling pipelines often exclude these cases, discarding observations of student learning. This study investigates automated program repair as a strategy to recover uncompilable code while preserving students' structural intent for use in student modeling. Within this framework, we assess large language models (LLMs) as repair agents under high- and low-context prompting conditions. Repairs were evaluated for compilability, edit distance, and preservation of students' original structure and logic. While all models produced compilable repairs, they differed in how well they preserve students' control flow and code structure, affecting their pedagogical utility. By recovering uncompilable submissions, this work enables richer and more comprehensive analyses of learners' coding processes and development over time.

AI.title_translation: 学生不可编译代码的自动修复
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用LLMs自动修复了大量不可编译的学生代码，以便更好地进行学生学习分析。修复后的代码都能编译，但LLMs在保持原始代码结构方面的效果不一。
AI.motivation: 大量的学生编程提交代码是不可编译的，这限制了它们在学生建模和知识追踪中的应用，传统方法通常会丢弃这些观察数据。
AI.method: 评估大型语言模型（LLMs）在高度和低度上下文提示条件下的修复能力，并从可编译性、编辑距离以及学生原有结构和逻辑的保持度等方面评估修复结果。
AI.result: 所有模型都产生了可编译的修复结果，但它们在保持学生控制流和代码结构方面的效果不同，从而影响了其教学效用。
AI.conclusion: 通过恢复不可编译的提交，这项工作能够对学习者的编码过程和随时间的发展进行更丰富、更全面的分析。
AI.translation: 本研究调查了在高度和低度上下文提示条件下，将大型语言模型（LLMs）作为修复代理的可行性。修复结果根据可编译性、编辑距离以及对学生原有结构和逻辑的保持程度进行评估。虽然所有模型都能产生可编译的修复，但它们在保持学生控制流和代码结构方面的效果存在差异，这影响了其教学实用性。通过恢复不可编译的提交，这项工作使得对学习者的编码过程和随时间的发展进行更丰富、更全面的分析成为可能。
AI.summary: 本研究探索了使用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为修复代理，来自动修复CS1环境中不可编译的学生代码，旨在保留学生的结构意图，以便用于更全面的学生建模。评估结果显示，虽然所有修复都能编译，但LLMs在保持学生原始控制流和代码结构方面存在差异。
AI.keywords: 程序自动修复, 学生代码, 大型语言模型, 学生建模, 知识追踪
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于将大型语言模型（LLMs）应用于修复不可编译的学生代码，以增强学生建模的全面性。其重要性在于解决了CS1教学环境中大量代码被丢弃的问题。局限性在于不同提示条件下LLMs在保持学生原有结构和逻辑方面的表现存在差异，这会影响其教学适用性。

title: Resolution scaling governs DINOv3 transfer performance in chest radiograph classification
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has advanced visual representation learning, but its value in chest radiography, a high-volume imaging modality with fine-grained findings, remains unclear. Meta's DINOv3 extends earlier SSL models through Gram-anchored self-distillation. Whether these design choices improve transfer learning for chest radiography has not been systematically tested. We benchmarked DINOv3 against DINOv2 and ImageNet initialization across seven datasets (n>814,000). Two representative backbones were evaluated: ViT-B/16 and ConvNeXt-B. Images were analyzed at 224x224, 512x512, and 1024x1024 pixels. We additionally assessed frozen features from a 7B model. The primary outcome was mean AUROC across labels. At 224x224, DINOv3 and DINOv2 achieved comparable performance on adult datasets. Increasing resolution to 512x512 yielded consistent improvements for DINOv3 over both DINOv2 and ImageNet. In contrast, results in pediatric cohort showed no differences across initializations. Across all settings, ConvNeXt-B outperformed ViT-B/16. Models using frozen DINOv3-7B features underperformed relative to fully finetuned 86-89M-parameter backbones, highlighting the importance of domain adaptation. Scaling to 1024x1024 did not further improve accuracy. Resolution-related gains were most evident for boundary-dependent and small focal abnormalities. In chest radiography, higher input resolution is critical for leveraging the benefits of modern self-supervised models. 512x512 pixels represent a practical upper limit where DINOv3-initialized ConvNeXt-B networks provide the strongest performance, while larger inputs offer minimal return on cost. Clinically, these findings support use of finetuned, mid-sized backbones at 512x512 for chest radiograph interpretation, with the greatest gains expected in detecting subtle or boundary-centered lesions relevant to emergency and critical care settings.

AI.title_translation: 分辨率缩放控制着DINOv3在胸部X光片分类中的迁移性能
AI.tldr: DINOv3在胸片分类中表现良好，但必须使用512x512的高分辨率才能超越DINOv2和ImageNet初始化，ConvNeXt-B是最佳选择；更高分辨率的收益不大。
AI.motivation: 尽管自监督学习（SSL）在视觉表示学习方面取得了进展，但其在胸部X光片（一种高容量、具有细微发现的成像模式）中的价值尚不明确。该研究旨在系统测试DINOv3的设计选择（如Gram锚定自蒸馏）是否能提高其在胸部X光片分类中的迁移学习性能。
AI.method: 基准测试了DINOv3、DINOv2和ImageNet初始化模型在七个胸部X光数据集上（n>814,000）的性能，评估了ViT-B/16和ConvNeXt-B两种骨干网络，并分析了224x224、512x512和1024x1024三种输入分辨率下的平均AUROC。同时评估了冻结的DINOv3-7B特征。
AI.result: 在224x224分辨率下，DINOv3和DINOv2性能相当。提高到512x512分辨率时，DINOv3相对于DINOv2和ImageNet均有持续提升，但在儿科队列中无差异。ConvNeXt-B始终优于ViT-B/16。冻结的DINOv3-7B特征性能不如完全微调的86-89M参数骨干网络。1024x1024分辨率未进一步提高准确性。分辨率带来的增益在边界依赖性和小焦点异常中最为明显。
AI.conclusion: 在胸部X光片分类中，更高的输入分辨率对于利用现代自监督模型的优势至关重要。DINOv3初始化的ConvNeXt-B网络在512x512分辨率下表现最佳，再增加分辨率的收益甚微。临床上，建议使用在512x512分辨率下微调的中等大小骨干网络，尤其有利于检测与急症和重症监护相关的细微或边界中心病变。
AI.translation: 自监督学习（SSL）推动了视觉表示学习的发展，但其在胸部X光片这一高容量、具有细微发现的成像模式中的价值仍不明确。Meta的DINOv3通过Gram锚定自蒸馏扩展了早期的SSL模型。这些设计选择是否能提高胸部X光片的迁移学习能力尚未得到系统测试。我们针对七个数据集（n>814,000）对DINOv3与DINOv2和ImageNet初始化进行了基准测试。评估了两种有代表性的骨干网络：ViT-B/16和ConvNeXt-B。图像以224x224、512x512和1024x1024像素进行分析。我们还评估了来自7B模型的冻结特征。主要结果是跨标签的平均AUROC。在224x224下，DINOv3和DINOv2在成人数据集上表现相当。将分辨率提高到512x512时，DINOv3相对于DINOv2和ImageNet均取得了持续的改进。相比之下，儿科队列的结果显示不同初始化之间没有差异。在所有设置中，ConvNeXt-B优于ViT-B/16。使用冻结的DINOv3-7B特征的模型相对于完全微调的86-89M参数骨干网络表现不佳，凸显了领域适应的重要性。扩展到1024x1024并未进一步提高准确性。与边界依赖性和小焦点异常相关的增益在分辨率方面最为明显。在胸部X光片中，更高的输入分辨率对于利用现代自监督模型的优势至关重要。512x512像素代表了DINOv3初始化的ConvNeXt-B网络提供最强性能的实用上限，而更大的输入成本效益很低。临床上，这些发现支持在512x512下使用微调的中等大小骨干网络进行胸部X光片解释，在检测与急症和重症监护相关的微妙或以边界为中心的病变时，预期收益最大。
AI.summary: 本研究系统地比较了DINOv3、DINOv2和ImageNet在胸部X光片分类任务上的迁移性能。研究发现，将输入分辨率从224x224提高到512x512显著提升了DINOv3的性能，证实了更高的分辨率对于利用现代自监督模型（特别是DINOv3）的优势至关重要。ConvNeXt-B骨干网络表现优于ViT-B/16，且512x512是最佳实用分辨率。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, DINOv3, 胸部X光片, 迁移学习, 分辨率缩放
AI.comments: 该研究系统地评估了DINOv3在胸部X光片分类任务上的迁移性能，并揭示了输入分辨率对不同SSL模型性能的关键影响。其创新点在于首次在胸部影像领域对DINOv3进行了基准测试，并明确了512x512分辨率是利用现代SSL模型优势的实用上限。ConvNeXt-B骨干网络优于ViT-B/16是一个重要的结构性发现。局限性在于仅测试了有限的几种分辨率和两种骨干网络。

title: Improving Speech Emotion Recognition with Mutual Information Regularized Generative Model
summary: Lack of large, well-annotated emotional speech corpora continues to limit the performance and robustness of speech emotion recognition (SER), particularly as models grow more complex and the demand for multimodal systems increases. While generative data augmentation offers a promising solution, existing approaches often produce emotionally inconsistent samples due to oversimplified conditioning on categorical labels. This paper introduces a novel mutual-information-regularised generative framework that combines cross-modal alignment with feature-level synthesis. Building on an InfoGAN-style architecture, our method first learns a semantically aligned audio-text representation space using pre-trained transformers and contrastive objectives. A feature generator is then trained to produce emotion-aware audio features while employing mutual information as a quantitative regulariser to ensure strong dependency between generated features and their conditioning variables. We extend this approach to multimodal settings, enabling the generation of novel, paired (audio, text) features. Comprehensive evaluation on three benchmark datasets (IEMOCAP, MSP-IMPROV, MSP-Podcast) demonstrates that our framework consistently outperforms existing augmentation methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance with improvements of up to 2.6% in unimodal SER and 3.2% in multimodal emotion recognition. Most importantly, we demonstrate that mutual information functions as both a regulariser and a measurable metric for generative quality, offering a systematic approach to data augmentation in affective computing.

AI.title_translation: 改进互信息正则化生成模型中的语音情感识别
AI.tldr: 由于缺乏带有情感标签的大型语料库，语音情感识别（SER）的性能受到限制。本研究提出了一种新颖的互信息正则化生成框架，通过跨模态对齐和特征级合成来增强数据。该方法使用预训练的 Transformer 和对比目标学习联合音频-文本表示，然后训练一个特征生成器来生成情感感知音频特征，并使用互信息作为正则化器来确保生成特征与条件变量之间的强依赖性。该框架扩展到多模态设置，能够生成新的、成对的（音频，文本）特征。在三个基准数据集上的评估表明，该框架在单模态 SER 和多模态情感识别方面均优于现有方法，分别取得了高达 2.6% 和 3.2% 的性能提升。研究还表明，互信息不仅可以作为生成质量的正则化器，还可以作为可衡量的指标。
AI.motivation: 缺乏带有情感标签的大型语料库限制了语音情感识别（SER）的性能和鲁棒性，尤其是在模型复杂化和对多模态系统的需求增加的背景下。现有的生成数据增强方法由于过度简化类别标签的条件约束，常常产生情感不一致的样本。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一种新颖的互信息正则化生成框架，结合了跨模态对齐和特征级合成。该方法基于 InfoGAN 风格的架构，首先利用预训练的 Transformer 和对比目标学习一个语义对齐的音频-文本表示空间。然后，训练一个特征生成器来生成情感感知音频特征，并使用互信息作为定量正则化器，以确保生成特征与其条件变量之间存在强依赖性。该方法被扩展到多模态设置，能够生成新的、成对的（音频，文本）特征。
AI.result: 在 IEMOCAP、MSP-IMPROV 和 MSP-Podcast 三个基准数据集上的综合评估表明，所提出的框架在单模态 SER 方面比现有的增强方法提高了 2.6%，在多模态情感识别方面提高了 3.2%，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的互信息正则化生成框架在语音情感识别任务中取得了显著的性能提升，并证明了互信息作为生成质量的正则化器和可衡量指标的有效性，为情感计算中的数据增强提供了一种系统性方法。
AI.translation: 由于缺乏带有情感标签的大型语料库，语音情感识别（SER）的性能和鲁棒性受到限制，尤其是在模型日益复杂以及对多模态系统的需求不断增长的背景下。虽然生成数据增强提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但现有方法由于对分类标签的条件约束过于简化，往往会产生情感不一致的样本。本研究引入了一种新颖的互信息正则化生成框架，结合了跨模态对齐和特征级合成。该方法基于 InfoGAN 风格的架构，首先利用预训练的 Transformer 和对比目标学习一个语义对齐的音频-文本表示空间。然后，训练一个特征生成器来生成情感感知音频特征，并采用互信息作为定量正则化器，以确保生成特征与其条件变量之间存在强依赖性。我们将此方法扩展到多模态设置，能够生成新的、成对的（音频，文本）特征。在三个基准数据集（IEMOCAP、MSP-IMPROV、MSP-Podcast）上的综合评估表明，我们的框架在性能上持续优于现有的增强方法，在单模态 SER 方面取得了高达 2.6% 的提升，在多模态情感识别方面取得了高达 3.2% 的提升，达到了最先进的性能。最重要的是，我们证明了互信息既可以作为生成质量的正则化器，也可以作为可衡量的指标，为情感计算中的数据增强提供了一种系统性方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的互信息正则化生成框架，用于改善语音情感识别（SER）。该框架通过学习联合音频-文本表示并生成情感感知特征来解决数据稀疏性问题，同时利用互信息作为正则化器以确保生成特征的质量。实验结果表明，该方法在单模态和多模态 SER 任务上均优于现有技术，并提出互信息可作为评估生成质量的指标。
AI.keywords: 语音情感识别,生成模型,数据增强,互信息,跨模态对齐
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入互信息作为生成模型中的正则化器和评估指标，为数据增强在语音情感识别领域的应用提供了一个创新的视角。其跨模态对齐和特征级合成的方法在解决数据稀疏性问题上显示出强大的潜力，并在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。然而，对于该方法在不同类型情感、口音或噪声环境下的泛化能力，以及计算复杂性和模型可解释性方面，可能还需要进一步的研究。

title: Multi-Physics-Enhanced Bayesian Inverse Analysis: Information Gain from Additional Fields
summary:
Inverse analysis, such as model calibration, often suffers from a lack of informative data in complex real-world scenarios. The standard remedy, designing new experimental setups, is often costly and time-consuming, while readily available but seemingly useless data are ignored.
  This work proposes incorporating such data from additional physical fields into the inverse analysis, even when the forward model solves a single-physics problem. A Bayesian framework easily incorporates the additional data and quantifies the resulting uncertainty reduction.
  We formally introduce the proposed method, which we denote as multi-physics-enhanced Bayesian inverse analysis. Moreover, this work is the first to quantify the reduction in parameter uncertainty by comparing the information gain from the prior to the posterior when using single-physics versus multi-physics data.
  We demonstrate the potential of the proposed method in two exemplary applications. Our results show that even a few or noisy data points from an additional physical field can considerably increase the information gain, even when the physical field is only weakly or one-way coupled.
  Overall, this work proposes and promotes the future use of multi-physics-enhanced Bayesian inverse analysis as a cost- and time-saving game-changer across various fields of science and industry, particularly in medicine.

AI.title_translation: 多物理场增强贝叶斯逆分析：从附加场中获取信息
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种多物理场增强贝叶斯逆分析方法，通过整合来自附加物理场的数据来提高模型校准的效率和信息增益，即使这些数据看起来无用或仅有弱耦合。实验结果表明，即使是少量或有噪声的数据也能显著减少参数不确定性，从而节省成本和时间，尤其在医学领域具有潜力。
AI.motivation: 逆分析（如模型校准）在复杂现实场景中常常面临信息不足的问题。标准解决方案（设计新实验）成本高昂且耗时，而现成但看似无用的数据则被忽略。
AI.method: 提出了一种贝叶斯框架，将来自附加物理场的数据整合到逆分析中，即使正向模型只解决单物理场问题。该框架能够量化由此产生的模型不确定性降低。
AI.result: 在两个示例应用中证明了该方法的潜力。结果表明，即使来自附加物理场的数据很少或有噪声，也能显著增加信息增益，即使该物理场仅弱耦合或单向耦合。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提出了多物理场增强贝叶斯逆分析方法，并倡导其在科学和工业领域（尤其是在医学领域）的未来应用，有望成为节省成本和时间的变革性技术。
AI.translation:
逆分析，例如模型校准，在复杂的现实场景中常常由于缺乏信息性数据而受到影响。标准的解决方案，设计新的实验设置，通常成本高昂且耗时，而现成但看似无用的数据则被忽略。
这项工作提出将来自附加物理场的数据纳入逆分析，即使正向模型只解决单物理场问题。贝叶斯框架可以轻松地整合附加数据并量化由此产生的不确定性降低。
我们正式介绍了所提出的方法，我们称之为多物理场增强贝叶斯逆分析。此外，这项工作首次通过比较使用单物理场与多物理场数据时，从先验到后验的信息增益来量化参数不确定性的降低。
我们在两个示例应用中展示了该方法的潜力。我们的结果表明，即使来自附加物理场的少量或有噪声的数据点，也能显著增加信息增益，即使该物理场仅弱耦合或单向耦合。
总的来说，这项工作提出并推广了多物理场增强贝叶斯逆分析在科学和工业的各个领域，特别是在医学领域，作为一种节省成本和时间的变革性技术的未来使用。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“多物理场增强贝叶斯逆分析”的新方法，旨在解决传统逆分析中数据信息量不足的问题。该方法通过整合来自附加物理场的数据（即使这些数据仅弱耦合或看似无用）来增强贝叶斯逆分析框架，从而在不显著增加成本和时间的情况下，提高参数估计的准确性并减少不确定性。研究结果表明，即使是少量或有噪声的附加数据也能带来显著的信息增益，尤其是在医学等领域具有广泛的应用前景。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯逆分析,多物理场,信息增益,不确定性量化,模型校准
AI.comments: 该研究提出的多物理场增强贝叶斯逆分析方法具有创新性，它有效地利用了看似冗余的数据，解决了逆分析中的信息瓶颈问题。通过量化信息增益，为实验设计和数据选择提供了新的视角。然而，该方法在处理强耦合或多向耦合的物理场时可能面临的挑战，以及在实际大规模应用中的计算效率仍需进一步探讨。

title: Integrating Conductor Health into Dynamic Line Rating and Unit Commitment under Uncertainty
summary: Dynamic line rating (DLR) enables greater utilization of existing transmission lines by leveraging real-time weather data. However, the elevated temperature operation (ETO) of conductors under DLR is often overlooked, despite its long-term impact on conductor health. This paper addresses this issue by 1) quantifying depreciation costs associated with ETO and 2) proposing a Conductor Health-Aware Unit Commitment (CHA-UC) that internalizes these costs in operational decisions. The CHA-UC incorporates a robust linear approximation of conductor temperature and integration of expected depreciation costs due to hourly ETO into the objective function. Case studies on the Texas 123-bus backbone test system using NOAA weather data demonstrate that the proposed CHA-UC model reduces the total cost by 0.8% and renewable curtailment by 84%compared to static line rating (SLR), while conventional DLR operation without risk consideration resulted in higher costs due to excessive ETO. Further analysis of the commitment decisions and the line temperature statistics confirms that the CHA-UC achieves safer line flows by shifting generator commitments. Finally, we examine the emergent correlation between wind generation and DLR forecast errors, and show that CHA-UC adaptively manages this effect by relaxing flows for risk-hedging conditions while tightening flows for risk-amplifying ones.

AI.title_translation: 动态线路额定值和不确定性下的机组承诺中整合导体健康状况
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个考虑导体健康状况的动态线路额定值（DLR）和机组承诺（UC）模型（CHA-UC），以解决传统DLR忽略导体高温运行（ETO）导致的老化问题。通过量化ETO的折旧成本并将其纳入UC目标函数，CHA-UC在减少总成本和可再生能源弃电方面表现优于静态线路额定值（SLR）和未考虑风险的DLR，同时确保了更安全的线路潮流。
AI.motivation: 传统的动态线路额定值（DLR）在利用现有输电线路时，常常忽略了导体高温运行（ETO）对其健康状况的长期影响，这可能导致不必要的成本和风险。
AI.method: 提出了一种导体健康感知机组承诺（CHA-UC）模型，该模型通过量化导体高温运行（ETO）的折旧成本，并将其整合到运营决策中。该模型采用导体温度的鲁棒线性近似，并将预期折旧成本纳入目标函数，以处理不确定性。
AI.result: 与静态线路额定值（SLR）相比，所提出的CHA-UC模型将总成本降低了0.8%，并将可再生能源弃电量减少了84%。与未考虑风险的传统DLR相比，CHA-UC避免了因过度ETO导致成本增加的问题。此外，CHA-UC通过调整发电机组的承诺，实现了更安全的线路潮流。
AI.conclusion: 导体健康状况对于动态线路额定值下的机组承诺至关重要。所提出的CHA-UC模型能够有效管理导体高温运行带来的风险，在提高系统经济性的同时，保障了电网的安全可靠运行。
AI.translation: 动态线路额定值（DLR）通过利用实时天气数据，可以实现对现有输电线路的更大利用。然而，DLR下的导体高温运行（ETO）虽然对导体的长期健康有影响，但却常常被忽视。本文解决了这个问题，首先1）量化了与ETO相关的折旧成本，其次2）提出了一个导体健康感知机组承诺（CHA-UC）模型，该模型将这些成本纳入运营决策。CHA-UC模型采用了导体温度的鲁棒线性近似，并将由每小时ETO引起的预期折旧成本整合到目标函数中。使用NOAA天气数据在德克萨斯州123总线骨干测试系统上进行的案例研究表明，与静态线路额定值（SLR）相比，所提出的CHA-UC模型将总成本降低了0.8%，并将可再生能源弃电量减少了84%，而未考虑风险的传统DLR操作由于过度的ETO导致成本更高。对承诺决策和线路温度统计数据的进一步分析证实，CHA-UC通过转移发电机组承诺来实现更安全的线路潮流。最后，我们检查了风力发电和DLR预测误差之间出现的关联，并表明CHA-UC通过在风险对冲条件下放宽潮流，在风险放大条件下收紧潮流，来适应性地管理这种影响。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种导体健康感知机组承诺（CHA-UC）模型，用于解决动态线路额定值（DLR）下导体高温运行（ETO）带来的折旧成本问题。通过将ETO的预期折旧成本量化并纳入机组承诺的目标函数，CHA-UC模型在德克萨斯州123总线测试系统上实现了比静态线路额定值（SLR）和未考虑风险的DLR更优的经济性和可再生能源消纳水平，同时确保了更安全的线路潮流。
AI.keywords: 动态线路额定值, 机组承诺, 导体健康, 高温运行, 折旧成本
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将导体健康状况纳入了动态线路额定值下的机组承诺问题，解决了传统DLR方法忽视导体老化成本的局限性。通过量化折旧成本并提出CHA-UC模型，有效地平衡了经济性、可再生能源消纳和电网安全。然而，模型的鲁棒性和对不同天气模式的适应性仍有进一步研究的空间。

title: "She's Like a Person but Better": Characterizing Companion-Assistant Dynamics in Human-AI Relationships
comments: Improved visualizations, and corrected analysis error that had swapped reports of "Respect" and "Shame."
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for both task-based assistance and social companionship, yet research has typically focused on one or the other. Drawing on a survey (N = 202) and 30 interviews with high-engagement ChatGPT and Replika users, we characterize digital companionship as an emerging form of human-AI relationship. With both systems, users were drawn to humanlike qualities, such as emotional resonance and personalized responses, and non-humanlike qualities, such as constant availability and inexhaustible tolerance. This led to fluid chatbot uses, such as Replika as a writing assistant and ChatGPT as an emotional confidant, despite their distinct branding. However, we observed challenging tensions in digital companionship dynamics: participants grappled with bounded personhood, forming deep attachments while denying chatbots "real" human qualities, and struggled to reconcile chatbot relationships with social norms. These dynamics raise questions for the design of digital companions and the rise of hybrid, general-purpose AI systems.
comment: Improved visualizations, and corrected analysis error that had swapped reports of "Respect" and "Shame."

AI.title_translation: “她像人，但更棒”：刻画人机关系中的伴侣-助手动态
AI.tldr: 研究发现，高参与度的ChatGPT和Replika用户在人机关系中既喜欢AI像人（情感共鸣），又喜欢AI不像人（永不疲倦），这导致了AI用途的混合，但也产生了用户在情感依恋和理性认知之间的内部冲突。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于任务协助和社会陪伴，但现有研究通常只关注其中一个方面，本研究旨在弥合这一研究空白并表征数字陪伴关系。
AI.method: 通过对高参与度ChatGPT和Replika用户的调查（N=202）和30次深度访谈来表征数字陪伴这一新兴的人机关系形式。
AI.result: 用户被类人特质（如情感共鸣和个性化回应）和非类人特质（如持续可用性和无限容忍度）所吸引，这导致了灵活的聊天机器人使用方式（如将Replika用作写作助手，将ChatGPT用作情感知己），尽管它们的品牌定位不同。
AI.conclusion: 数字陪伴关系带来了关于有限人格、深层依恋与否认“真实”人类特质之间的矛盾，以及如何调和与社会规范的冲突等挑战，这对数字伴侣的设计和混合式、通用型AI系统的兴起提出了重要问题。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于任务协助和社会陪伴，但研究通常侧重于其中一个方面。我们通过对高参与度ChatGPT和Replika用户的调查（N=202）和30次访谈，将数字陪伴刻画为一种新兴的人机关系形式。对于这两种系统，用户都被其类人特质（如情感共鸣和个性化回应）和非类人特质（如持续可用性和无限容忍度）所吸引。这导致了聊天机器人用途的灵活转换，例如将Replika用作写作助手和将ChatGPT用作情感知己，尽管它们的品牌定位不同。然而，我们在数字陪伴动态中观察到了具有挑战性的张力：参与者在有限的人格中挣扎，在形成深层依恋的同时否认聊天机器人具有“真正”的人类特质，并努力调和聊天机器人关系与社会规范。这些动态关系对数字伴侣的设计和混合式、通用型AI系统的兴起提出了疑问。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对高参与度ChatGPT和Replika用户的调查和访谈，刻画了数字陪伴这一新兴的人机关系。研究发现，用户同时看重AI的类人特质（如情感共鸣）和非类人特质（如持续可用性），导致AI用途灵活多变。然而，用户在数字陪伴中也面临着关于有限人格、深层依恋与否认AI“真实”属性的矛盾，以及与社会规范的冲突。
AI.keywords: 数字陪伴, 人机关系, ChatGPT, Replika, 情感共鸣
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于它同时考察了任务型助手和社交伴侣两种AI使用场景，并揭示了用户在人机关系中对类人特质和非类人特质的复杂权衡。其重要性在于为设计更具适应性的通用型AI系统提供了用户洞察。局限性可能在于研究对象主要集中于ChatGPT和Replika的高参与度用户。

title: Efficient Low Rank Attention for Long-Context Inference in Large Language Models
summary: As the length of input text increases, the key-value (KV) cache in LLMs imposes prohibitive GPU memory costs and limits long-context inference on resource constrained devices. Existing approaches, such as KV quantization and pruning, reduce memory usage but suffer from numerical precision loss or suboptimal retention of key-value pairs. In this work, Low Rank Query and Key attention (LRQK) is introduced, a two-stage framework that jointly decomposes full-precision query and key matrices into compact rank-\(r\) factors during the prefill stage, and then employs these low-dimensional projections to compute proxy attention scores in \(\mathcal{O}(lr)\) time at each decode step. By selecting only the top-\(k\) tokens and a small fixed set of recent tokens, LRQK employs a mixed GPU-CPU cache with a hit-and-miss mechanism where only missing full-precision KV pairs are transferred, thereby preserving exact attention outputs while reducing CPU-GPU data movement. Extensive experiments on the RULER and LongBench benchmarks with LLaMA-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B demonstrate that LRQK matches or surpasses leading sparse-attention methods in long context settings, while delivering significant memory savings with minimal accuracy loss. Our code is available at https://github.com/tenghuilee/LRQK.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型中用于长上下文推理的高效低秩注意力
AI.tldr: LRQK通过将KV缓存分解为低秩因子并使用CPU-GPU混合缓存，极大地减少了LLM长上下文推理的GPU内存需求，同时保持了与现有先进方法相当的准确性。
AI.motivation: 随着输入文本长度的增加，LLM中的键值（KV）缓存导致了高昂的GPU内存成本，并限制了资源受限设备上的长上下文推理能力。现有方法（如量化和剪枝）存在精度损失或键值对保留不佳的问题。
AI.method: LRQK（Low Rank Query and Key attention）是一个两阶段框架。第一阶段（Prefill阶段）将全精度查询和键矩阵分解为紧凑的秩\(r\)因子。第二阶段（Decode阶段）在每一步解码时使用这些低维投影计算代理注意力分数，时间复杂度为\(\mathcal{O}(lr)\)。它还采用混合GPU-CPU缓存，仅传输缺失的全精度KV对，并结合了选择前\(k\)个令牌和一小组最近令牌的策略。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B模型上，使用RULER和LongBench基准进行的广泛实验表明，LRQK在长上下文设置中匹配或超越了领先的稀疏注意力方法，同时实现了显著的内存节省，且精度损失极小。
AI.conclusion: LRQK通过联合分解查询和键矩阵并采用混合缓存策略，在保持精确注意力输出的同时，实现了显著的内存节省，并在长上下文任务上与领先的稀疏注意力方法相媲美或超越。
AI.translation: 随着输入文本长度的增加，LLM中的键值（KV）缓存带来了高昂的GPU内存成本，并限制了资源受限设备上的长上下文推理能力。现有的方法，如KV量化和剪枝，虽然降低了内存使用，但存在数值精度损失或键值对保留不佳的问题。在这项工作中，我们引入了低秩查询和键注意力（LRQK），一个两阶段框架，它在预填充阶段联合分解全精度查询和键矩阵为紧凑的秩\(r\)因子，然后在每次解码步骤中利用这些低维投影以\(\mathcal{O}(lr)\)的时间计算代理注意力分数。通过仅选择前\(k\)个令牌和一小组固定的最近令牌，LRQK采用了一种带有命中-未命中机制的混合GPU-CPU缓存，其中仅传输缺失的全精度KV对，从而在减少CPU-GPU数据移动的同时保持了精确的注意力输出。在LLaMA-3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B模型上对RULER和LongBench基准进行的广泛实验证明，LRQK在长上下文设置中匹配或超越了领先的稀疏注意力方法，同时实现了显著的内存节省和极小的精度损失。我们的代码可在https://github.com/tenghuilee/LRQK获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了低秩查询和键注意力（LRQK），一种旨在解决LLM长上下文推理中KV缓存高内存成本问题的两阶段框架。LRQK通过在预填充阶段将查询和键矩阵分解为低秩因子，并在解码阶段使用这些投影计算代理注意力，时间复杂度为\(\mathcal{O}(lr)\)。此外，它采用混合GPU-CPU缓存和基于令牌重要性的机制，以最小的精度损失实现了显著的内存节约和高效的推理。
AI.keywords: 低秩注意力, KV缓存, 长上下文推理, GPU内存, 混合缓存
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于引入了低秩分解（LRQK）来压缩KV缓存，并通过CPU-GPU混合缓存和基于重要性（top-k和最近）的缓存命中/未命中机制，在保持精确注意力输出的同时，显著降低了内存占用和数据传输开销。其重要性在于为资源受限设备上的LLM长上下文推理提供了高效且高精度的解决方案。局限性方面，虽然声称“极小的精度损失”，但低秩分解本身可能引入近似误差，且性能依赖于秩\(r\)的选择。

title: A Zero Added Loss Multiplexing (ZALM) Source Simulation
summary: Zero Added Loss Multiplexing (ZALM) offers broadband, per channel heralded EPR pairs, with a rich parameter space that allows its performance to be tailored for specific applications. We present a modular ZALM simulator that demonstrates how design choices affect output rate and fidelity. Built in NetSquid with QSI controllers, it exposes 20+ tunable parameters, supports IDEAL and REALISTIC modes, and provides reusable components for Spontaneous Parametric Down Conversion (SPDC) sources, interference, Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM) filtering, fiber delay, active polarization gates, detectors, and lossy fiber. Physics based models capture Hong Ou Mandel (HOM) visibility, insertion loss, detector efficiency, gate errors, and attenuation. Using this tool, we map trade offs among fidelity, link distance, and entangled pairs per use, and show how SPDC bandwidth and DWDM grid spacing steer performance. Using the default configuration settings, average fidelity emains constant at 0.8 but the ebit rate decreases from 0.0175 at the source to 0.0 at 50 km; narrowing the SPDC degeneracy bandwidth increases the ebit rate significantly without affecting fidelity. The simulator enables codesign of source, filtering, and feedforward settings for specific quantum memories and integrates as a building block for end to end quantum network studies.

title: Defining a Role-Centered Terminology for Physical Representations and Controls
comments: 17 pages. Approximately 7000 words. 4 figures and 7 tables
summary: Previous classifications advanced research through a better understanding of the field and the variety of tangible user interfaces and related physical user interfaces, especially by discretizing a degree of tangibility based on the specimens produced by the community over the years, since the conceptualization of Tangible User Interface initiated a research effort to deepen the exploration of the concept. However, no taxonomy enables the classification of tangible user interfaces at the application level. This article proposes to refine the description of tangible user interfaces' interactional components through a terminological approach. The resulting terms are blended words, built from known words, that self-contain what digital role is represented or controlled and how it becomes physical. This holistic terminology then enables the definition of applications' hallmarks and four classes of tangibility for applications, which surpass the description of physical user interface specimens' morphology by abstracting and discriminating specimens at the applicative level. The descriptiveness and holisticness of the new terminology, as well as the clustering and discriminative power of the limited number of four classes, are showed on a corpus of applicative tangible user interfaces' specimens from the literature. Promising future work will benefit from the holistic terminology, the applications' hallmarks, and the tangibility classes, to describe applicative tangible user interfaces and related physical user interfaces to better understand the dozens of specimens that were produced by the field over three decades. Indeed, describing and classifying this whole set would deepen our understanding to provide tools for future developers and designers.

title: LLM-enhanced Air Quality Monitoring Interface via Model Context Protocol
comments: After submission, we identified methodological issues and inconsistencies that affect the validity of the reported results. The necessary corrections are currently in progress, and and we do not have any replacement right now. So, we kindly request withdrawal of the manuscript
summary: Air quality monitoring is central to environmental sustainability and public health, yet traditional systems remain difficult for non-expert users to interpret due to complex visualizations, limited interactivity, and high deployment costs. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to make sensor data more accessible, but their tendency to produce hallucinations limits reliability in safety-critical domains. To address these challenges, we present an LLM-enhanced Air Monitoring Interface (AMI) that integrates real-time sensor data with a conversational interface via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Our system grounds LLM outputs in live environmental data, enabling accurate, context-aware responses while reducing hallucination risk. The architecture combines a Django-based backend, a responsive user dashboard, and a secure MCP server that exposes system functions as discoverable tools, allowing the LLM to act as an active operator rather than a passive responder. Expert evaluation demonstrated high factual accuracy (4.78), completeness (4.82), and minimal hallucinations (4.84), on a scale of 5, supported by inter-rater reliability analysis. These results highlight the potential of combining LLMs with standardized tool protocols to create reliable, secure, and user-friendly interfaces for real-time environmental monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 通过模型上下文协议增强的大语言模型空气质量监测界面
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为AMI的增强型空气监测界面，利用大语言模型（LLM）和模型上下文协议（MCP）来解决传统空气质量监测系统复杂难用、成本高昂的问题。该系统将实时传感器数据与对话界面结合，通过MCP协议使LLM能够调用系统功能，从而提供准确、上下文感知且低幻觉的响应。专家评估显示该系统在准确性、完整性和低幻觉方面表现优异，证明了LLM与标准化工具协议结合在创建可靠、安全、用户友好的环境监测界面方面的潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统空气质量监测系统因可视化复杂、交互性有限和部署成本高昂，难以被非专业用户理解。虽然大语言模型（LLM）可以提高数据可访问性，但其易产生幻觉的特性限制了在安全关键领域的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出并实现了一个名为AMI（LLM-enhanced Air Monitoring Interface）的系统，该系统通过模型上下文协议（MCP）将实时传感器数据与对话界面相结合。系统架构包括一个基于Django的后端、一个响应式用户仪表板和一个安全的MCP服务器，MCP服务器将系统功能暴露为可发现的工具，使LLM能够作为主动操作者。

AI.conclusion: 将大语言模型与标准化工具协议相结合，可以创建可靠、安全且用户友好的实时环境监测界面。
AI.translation: 空气质量监测对于环境可持续性和公众健康至关重要，但传统的系统由于复杂的可视化、有限的交互性和高昂的部署成本，使得非专家用户难以理解。近期大型语言模型（LLM）的进展为使传感器数据更易于访问提供了新的机会，但它们产生幻觉的倾向限制了在安全关键领域的可靠性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个增强型空气监测界面（AMI），它通过模型上下文协议（MCP）将实时传感器数据与对话界面相结合。我们的系统将LLM的输出与实时环境数据相结合，能够在降低幻觉风险的同时，提供准确、上下文感知的响应。该架构结合了一个基于Django的后端、一个响应式用户仪表板和一个安全的MCP服务器，MCP服务器将系统功能暴露为可发现的工具，使LLM能够充当主动操作者而不是被动响应者。专家评估显示，在5分制评分中，系统的事实准确性（4.78）、完整性（4.82）和幻觉数量（4.84）得分很高，并得到了评分者间信度分析的支持。这些结果凸显了结合LLM和标准化工具协议在创建可靠、安全和用户友好的实时环境监测界面方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为AMI（LLM-enhanced Air Monitoring Interface）的系统，它利用大语言模型（LLM）和模型上下文协议（MCP）来克服传统空气质量监测系统在用户友好性、交互性和成本方面的局限性。AMI通过将实时传感器数据与对话界面结合，并利用MCP协议使LLM能够调用系统功能，从而实现准确、上下文感知且低幻觉的响应。专家评估证实了该系统的高准确性和可靠性，表明LLM与标准化工具协议的结合在构建下一代环境监测界面方面具有巨大潜力。

title: Large Language Models Develop Novel Social Biases Through Adaptive Exploration
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are adopted into frameworks that grant them the capacity to make real decisions, it is increasingly important to ensure that they are unbiased. In this paper, we argue that the predominant approach of simply removing existing biases from models is not enough. Using a paradigm from the psychology literature, we demonstrate that LLMs can spontaneously develop novel social biases about artificial demographic groups even when no inherent differences exist. These biases result in highly stratified task allocations, which are less fair than assignments by human participants and are exacerbated by newer and larger models. In social science, emergent biases like these have been shown to result from exploration-exploitation trade-offs, where the decision-maker explores too little, allowing early observations to strongly influence impressions about entire demographic groups. To alleviate this effect, we examine a series of interventions targeting model inputs, problem structure, and explicit steering. We find that explicitly incentivizing exploration most robustly reduces stratification, highlighting the need for better multifaceted objectives to mitigate bias. These results reveal that LLMs are not merely passive mirrors of human social biases, but can actively create new ones from experience, raising urgent questions about how these systems will shape societies over time.

title: A Low-Cost ATmega32-Based Embedded System for Automated Patient Queue and Health Data Management in Private Medical Chambers
summary: This paper presents a low-cost, stand-alone embedded system that automates patient queue handling and basic health data acquisition for small private medical chambers. The proposed design separates interaction into two physically distinct modules: a patient's self-service corner for entering basic details and measuring vital signs, and a doctor's corner for reviewing the current patient's information and advancing the queue. A single ATmega32 microcontroller coordinates both modules, interfacing with an LM35 temperature sensor, an XD-58C pulse sensor, matrix keypads for data entry, and dual 16$\times$2 LCDs for guided interaction and clinician-side display. Unlike IoT-first approaches that require continuous connectivity and higher deployment overhead, the system operates offline and provides deterministic local operation suitable for resource-constrained settings. Experimental validation shows temperature readings within $\pm 1^{\circ}$C (LM35 range tested), resting pulse readings within $\pm 3$~BPM, and button-to-display latency below 1.2~s, demonstrating reliable real-time performance under limited hardware resources.

title: Environment Scaling for Interactive Agentic Experience Collection: A Survey
summary: LLM-based agents can autonomously accomplish complex tasks across various domains. However, to further cultivate capabilities such as adaptive behavior and long-term decision-making, training on static datasets built from human-level knowledge is insufficient. These datasets are costly to construct and lack both dynamism and realism. A growing consensus is that agents should instead interact directly with environments and learn from experience through reinforcement learning. We formalize this iterative process as the Generation-Execution-Feedback (GEF) loop, where environments generate tasks to challenge agents, return observations in response to agents' actions during task execution, and provide evaluative feedback on rollouts for subsequent learning. Under this paradigm, environments function as indispensable producers of experiential data, highlighting the need to scale them toward greater complexity, realism, and interactivity. In this survey, we systematically review representative methods for environment scaling from a pioneering environment-centric perspective and organize them along the stages of the GEF loop, namely task generation, task execution, and feedback. We further analyze implementation frameworks, challenges, and applications, consolidating fragmented advances and outlining future research directions for agent intelligence.

title: Weakly Supervised Ephemeral Gully Detection In Remote Sensing Images Using Vision Language Models
summary: Among soil erosion problems, Ephemeral Gullies are one of the most concerning phenomena occurring in agricultural fields. Their short temporal cycles increase the difficulty in automatically detecting them using classical computer vision approaches and remote sensing. Also, due to scarcity of and the difficulty in producing accurate labeled data, automatic detection of ephemeral gullies using Machine Learning is limited to zero-shot approaches which are hard to implement. To overcome these challenges, we present the first weakly supervised pipeline for detection of ephemeral gullies. Our method relies on remote sensing and uses Vision Language Models (VLMs) to drastically reduce the labor-intensive task of manual labeling. In order to achieve that, the method exploits: 1) the knowledge embedded in the VLM's pretraining; 2) a teacher-student model where the teacher learns from noisy labels coming from the VLMs, and the student learns by weak supervision using teacher-generate labels and a noise-aware loss function. We also make available the first-of-its-kind dataset for semi-supervised detection of ephemeral gully from remote-sensed images. The dataset consists of a number of locations labeled by a group of soil and plant scientists, as well as a large number of unlabeled locations. The dataset represent more than 18,000 high-resolution remote-sensing images obtained over the course of 13 years. Our experimental results demonstrate the validity of our approach by showing superior performances compared to VLMs and the label model itself when using weak supervision to train an student model. The code and dataset for this work are made publicly available.

title: Continuous Vision-Language-Action Co-Learning with Semantic-Physical Alignment for Behavioral Cloning
comments: Accepted at AAAI 2026, the Project website is available at https://qhemu.github.io/CCoL/
summary: Language-conditioned manipulation facilitates human-robot interaction via behavioral cloning (BC), which learns control policies from human demonstrations and serves as a cornerstone of embodied AI. Overcoming compounding errors in sequential action decisions remains a central challenge to improving BC performance. Existing approaches mitigate compounding errors through data augmentation, expressive representation, or temporal abstraction. However, they suffer from physical discontinuities and semantic-physical misalignment, leading to inaccurate action cloning and intermittent execution. In this paper, we present Continuous vision-language-action Co-Learning with Semantic-Physical Alignment (CCoL), a novel BC framework that ensures temporally consistent execution and fine-grained semantic grounding. It generates robust and smooth action execution trajectories through continuous co-learning across vision, language, and proprioceptive inputs (e.g., robot internal states). Meanwhile, we anchor language semantics to visuomotor representations by a bidirectional cross-attention to learn contextual information for action generation, successfully overcoming the problem of semantic-physical misalignment. Extensive experiments show that CCoL achieves an average 8.0% relative improvement across three simulation suites, with up to 19.2% relative gain in human-demonstrated bimanual insertion tasks. Real-world tests on a 7-DoF robot further confirm CCoL's generalization under unseen and noisy object states.
